entries.title: Megataur/TCG
entries.summary: Though a Megataur card was never released, one initially was planned to be released in the Labyrinth of Doom deck.

entries.title: Land Shark
entries.summary: Land Shark is a shark-like Draco-Titan used by Captain Caine.

entries.title: The Lost City of Casterwill
entries.summary: The Lost City of Casterwill is the 12th issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series and the final issue in the first series of comics.

entries.title: Barrage
entries.summary: Barrage is a veridian-colored Yama-Titan with a red, horned face. It dons golden chains and red armor, and bears large crystals on its back which it can use as offensive weapons. Its Amulet is in the possession of Gregor.

entries.title: The Seekers of Ys
entries.summary: Seeker of Ys is the 11th issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: Mission to Skara Brae
entries.summary: Mission to Skara Brae is the 10th issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: Suit Handbook
entries.summary: The Suit Handbook is a book containing pieces of advice and rules for Suits of the Organization.

entries.title: The Spiral Mark
entries.summary: Lok, Sophie and Dante face Rassimov and the Blood Spiral. Their attack on the Spiral Mark seems successful, until the spectral presence of the Betrayer reveals his diabolical plan, and the truth about the Red Comet.

entries.title: Rassimov's Secret
entries.summary: Using the Professor's files, the Huntik team coordinates an attack to capture Rassimov, but not everything goes to plan.

entries.title: Back Home
entries.summary: Resting at Lok's mother's house in Ireland, Scarlet Byrne enlists the Huntik team's help with a mission to find the legendary castle of Tír na nÓg. There, they uncover more secrets while Eathon Lambert coaches Lok on Willblade combat.

entries.title: Words from Eathon
entries.summary: The final battle shapes up as the longest night of the year begins. Lok, Dante, Sophie and Den head to the tomb of Nostradamus to find his last Quatrain. As they await Zhalia's signal, it is a race against time to get to the Spiral Mark.

entries.title: Blooded Circle
entries.summary: The Blooded Circle is a council consisting of the five highest level members of the Blood Spiral. Commanded by Rassimov, they would convene at the Throne of Lies, before Rassimov and the Betrayer's corpse, and plot their next moves. Each member's place in the circle is highly regarded, and if a member leaves, they must be replaced by a Seeker who has proven themself to be just as powerful.

entries.title: Chaingolem
entries.summary: Chaingolem is a Litho-Titan who is used by the Huntik Foundation and whose body is composed of a multitude of chains. He is a smaller, weaker counterpart to the other known golem Titans which include Metagolem, Coralgolem, Undergolem, and Brahe.

entries.title: An Ally from the Organization
entries.summary: Joined by an old enemy, a battle erupts between the Huntik team and Mr. Wilder at the Professor's castle, where Lok hopes to find an access key and retrieve Rassimov's file.

entries.title: Home Turf/Quotes
entries.summary:
"Once a Foundation girl, always a Foundation girl."
-Sandra Lambert

entries.title: Clease
entries.summary: Clease is an elderly Huntik Foundation operative based at Huntik Foundation Italian HQ in Venice. He holds the job of monitoring and training new Seekers.

entries.title: Akmen-Meo
entries.summary: Akmen-Meo is a cat-like Hecto-Titan whose hindquarters have decayed down to the bone. She wears a pharaoh's nemes upon her head.

entries.title: Whitmont
entries.summary: Whitmont is a master Seeker and treasure hunter, and a member of the Organization. His primary Titan is Akmen-Meo.

entries.title: Hector
entries.summary: Hector is a tomb raider and member of the Organization. His primary Titan is Iron Monkey.

entries.title: Numbers
entries.summary: Numbers is a member of the Organization. He is a loyal worker under Hector.

entries.title: Bloodrank
entries.summary: Bloodrank is a spell used by members of the Blood Spiral Brotherhood. This spell allows the user to sacrifice one or more Titans on their side in order to give their energy to power up a different Titan.

entries.title: Morgan the Knife
entries.summary: Morgan the Knife is a member of The Organization. He carries out jobs for them to earn profit.

hero type: Minor Hero (Major Hero and Minor Hero)

entries.title: Oddrey 2
entries.summary: Oddrey 2 is a Gaia-Titan which resembles a Venus flytrap. It was created by Klaus as one of his experiments. His first attempt, Oddrey 1, tried to eat Klaus and therefore was not a success.

entries.title: Omeed
entries.summary: Omeed is a member of the Organization who operates from somewhere on the continent of Africa.

entries.title: Dierdre
entries.summary: Dierdre is a Gaia-Titan who takes on the appearance of a green-toned maiden. embellished in glowing roots and vines.

entries.title: Paola
entries.summary: Paola is a member of the Huntik Foundation who looks after a safehouse where Foundation Seekers may rest or take refuge.

entries.title: Ferric Warbringer
entries.summary: Ferric Warbringer is a powerful Draco-Titan. As soon as he is unleashed, he rushes through the battlefield and fights his way through enemy lines with his vast arsenal of weaponry.

entries.title: Suits/Sandbox
entries.summary:
__NOTOC__
This page is to help organize information about the different Suit teams in order to expound upon the current information.

Suits are the lowest level minions of the Organization. Typically dressed in dark suits, they are the pawns whom the higher-level Organization operatives use to achieve their nefarious goals.

entries.title: Oddrey 1
entries.summary: Oddrey 1 is a monstrous plant creature created by Klaus as one of his experiments. This Titan tried to eat Klaus and, therefore, was not a success and was abandoned. Klaus continued the project, and the Titan was replaced by Oddrey 2.

entries.title: Kerosan
entries.summary: Kerosan is a devil-like Yama-Titan that uses her fire-based abilities to distract and to confuse her enemies. She has red skin and a devil-like tail and dons a fire-decorated kimono.

entries.title: Enderby
entries.summary: Enderby is a tutor to Sophie Casterwill and has great knowledge of and specializes in ancient riddles and ancient texts. He likes to drink a cup of tea. He wears a suit and glass monocle and has a prominent, sophisticated mustache.

entries.title: Enderby/Quotes
entries.summary:
"My specialty is ancient texts and riddles. Would you care to discuss them over a nice cup of tea?"
- Enderby (SAS-052 - Enderby: Casterwill Tutor)

"Stop lying around, Miss Casterwill. We have a job to do."

- Enderby, to Sophie (OAL-037 - Enderby: Gentleman)

entries.title: Spiral Mark
entries.summary: The Spiral Mark, located in Siberia, under the Blood Spiral Base, is an ancient magic sigil created by Void as a beacon to call the Nullifiers to Earth. It was sealed by Lord Casterwill and could only be re-activated when stabbed by the Willblade, combined with Void, with Phoenix flying up above, on the longest night of the year whilst the Red Comet was in the sky. The sigil itself became the symb

entries.title: Oversight
entries.summary: Oversight is spell able to prevent the target from noticing particular things. Using this spell casts a blue aura around the eyes of the target.

entries.title: Kabuki
entries.summary: Kabuki is a bleached-white Yama-Titan who wears a red kimono and has very long, black hair. Its face is painted like a kabuki performer. Kabuki's Amulet belongs to Teien Casterwill.

entries.title: Thresher
entries.summary: Thresher is a shark-like Titan used by the Professor. Much like its Draco-Titan cousin, Land Shark, it can travel on land as well as under water.

aliases: TCG:Suit - Ms. C. Hubbs, Venice Agent

entries.title: Crashion
entries.summary: Crashion is small blind bloodhound-like Litho-Titan.

entries.title: Nikola Tesla
entries.summary: Nikola Tesla was a scientist and engineer who was born in Serbia during the nineteenth century. In addition, Tesla was a Seeker.

entries.title: Calbolg
entries.summary: Calbolg is a Titan that can be specially summoned by Gybolg to fight alongside him and to form an army.

entries.title: Ghost Trap
entries.summary: A Ghost Trap is a type of magical, Casterwill family trap that leaves behind a green, ghostly version of the Seeker who summoned it. Two Ghost Traps were left to guard the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, one by Sir Lancelot himself and another in the image of Guinevere, his lover.

entries.title: Channelmight
entries.summary: Channelmight is a spell used to revitalize unconscious Titans and give them a new surge of energy. Though similar to Newlife, Channelmight is used on Titans who have lost consciousness without returning to their Amulets whereas Newlife is used on Titans who have returned to their Amulets.

entries.title: The Headless Horseman
entries.summary: The Headless Horseman is the seventh issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series, set in the renowned Sleepy Hollow.

entries.title: Casterwill Library
entries.summary: The Casterwill Library is located in the suburbs of Montmorency, Paris, France nearby the old Paris Casterwill house where Sophie Casterwill grew up. The library later served as the base of operations for Lucas Casterwill's team.

entries.title: Huntik Magazine
entries.summary: Huntik Magazine is a comic book series based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. It was released monthly in Italy and Europe by Tridimensional S.r.l. and Kappa Edizioni, beginning in March 2009 and ending in February 2012. In total, 18 issues were released, despite a 19th issue being ready for publication and a 20th being pencilled.

entries.title: The Fire of Georgiopolis
entries.summary: The Fire of Georgiopolis is the third issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: The Treasures of Alexandria
entries.summary: The Treasures of Alexandria is the fourth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: The Power of Kronos
entries.summary: The Power of Kronos is the seventeenth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic series and the penultimate comic to be released. The story takes place during the second season.

entries.title: The Carnival of Deception
entries.summary: The Carnival of Deception is the fifth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: The Titan's Island
entries.summary: The Titan's Island is the sixth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: Headless Hessian
entries.summary: Headless Hessian is a caped Draco-Titan horseman who wields a large curved sword. He bears golden armor as well as a fake, detachable pumpkin-like head which he hurls at his enemies.

stats.special_ability: Detachable head that can be used as a fireball

entries.title: The Curse of Venice
entries.summary: The Curse of Venice is the eighth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: Grand Dragon Leviathan (comic)
entries.summary: Grand Dragon Leviathan is the ninth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: The Secret of the Flying Dutchman
entries.summary: The Secret of the Flying Dutchman is the thirteenth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series and the first issue in the second series of comics.

entries.title: Cerberus (comic)
entries.summary: Cerberus is the fourteenth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: Gil
entries.summary: Gil is a 30 year-old researcher for the Huntik Foundation, his job being to analyse artifacts in case there are Titans hidden in them.

entries.title: Red Comet
entries.summary: The Red Comet was a comet which gave a lot of power to the Blood Spiral, and it can only be seen by Seekers. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun] It also served as a beacon for Nullifiers, signaling the re-emergence of the Blood Spiral. [Chasing Void] If it hits the Spiral Mark, it would bring the Nullifiers back.

entries.title: Viktor Casterwill
entries.summary: Viktor Casterwill was a corrupt Casterwill family member from the 17th century who attempted to steal the Ring of Kronos. He was the ancestor of Dr. Benway, a disowned Casterwill family member.

entries.title: The Bulls of Pamplona
entries.summary: The Bulls of Pamplona is the sixteenth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: Blackbull
entries.summary: Blackbull is a large bull-like Litho-Titan that is used by both Diaz and Snake.

entries.title: The Titan of the Stage
entries.summary: The Titan of the Stage is the fifteenth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: Gargoyle
entries.summary: The Gargoyle trap was a mechanical trap that guarded the Cave of the Gargoyle in order to prevent Gar-Ghoul's Amulet from being recovered.

entries.title: Lord Casterwill
entries.summary: Lord Casterwill was the first known Seeker in history and the ancestor of the powerful group of Seekers within the Casterwill family. Casterwill is best known for his leading the 500-year war against the Nullifiers and his bringing the Titans to Earth from Huntik. He was the original Seeker of the Legendary Titans. Many other details of his life, however, subsequently were lost to history.

entries.title: Pyramid of the Sun
entries.summary: The Pyramid of the Sun, also known as the Temple of Sun, is the largest temple in the Aztec capital of Teotihuacan, Mexico, and was dedicated to Quetzalcoatl, the Legendary Titan of Summons, whose Ring it contained. Using an ancient ritual, the temple could activate the Blue Star as part of an ancient signal to call the scattered Casterwill family members to reunite at the Fortress of Iron Will.

entries.title: Sandstorm
entries.summary: Sandstorm is an offensive Blood Spiral spell that creates a powerful rushing vortex of sand which can knock enemies out of a Seeker's path.

entries.title: Sir Lancelot
entries.summary: Sir Lancelot was a powerful Seeker who was head of one of the main Casterwill family branches. In ancient times, he searched for the Holy Grail and was the champion of King Arthur.

entries.title: Earthrift
entries.summary: Earthrift is a powerful Blood Spiral spell that sends a powerful wave of energy through the ground similar to Stoneblade however it can hit an enemy just by making contact with its target's shadow.

entries.title: Rahmas
entries.summary: Rahmas is a former Organization mercenary and agent of Rassimov. He bears the symbol of an ankh on his right arm.

entries.title: Typhoonbind
entries.summary: Typhoonbind is a spell that can hold an adversary for a few seconds with minimal effort. This spell manifests as pink rings of energy that form around the target to result in immobilization.

entries.title: Ghostwalk
entries.summary: Ghostwalk is an spell that allows the user to create portals through solid structures or floors, and walk through them like a ghost.

entries.title: Metzi
entries.summary: Metzi is Meso-Titan with a skull-like head decorated in a tribal headress. He is known to possess special Moon powers.

entries.title: Battlemaster
entries.summary: Battlemaster is a large, blue Krono-Titan who holds an entire battlefield above his head.

entries.title: Ghostfog
entries.summary: Ghostfog is a spectral Gaia-Titan made up of fog and smoke that belonged to the Dutch sailor, Captain Bernard Fokke. It left to reside legendary ghost ship, the Flying Dutchman, inspiring many tails of a haunted ship sailing across the ocean.

entries.title: Diaz
entries.summary: Diaz is an Organization commander. His second in command is his high-ranking Suit, Snake.

entries.title: Snake
entries.summary: Snake is a high-ranking Suit of the Organization and Diaz's right hand man. He has an unnerving scar running down one side of his face.

entries.title: Captain Caine
entries.summary: Captain Caine is a ruthless sea commander who works for the Organization. His job is to oversee water-based operations.

entries.title: Powerdrain
entries.summary: Powerdrain is a spell that directly drains the power of the target.

entries.title: Hamelin Cathedral
entries.summary: Hamelin Cathedral, located in the famous city of Hamelin, Germany, was the site of several incidents surrounding infestations of rat-like Titans known as Gremlow.

entries.title: Nikola Tesla's workshop
entries.summary: A workshop was the base for the Serbian scientist and Seeker, Nikola Tesla.

entries.title: Hernán Cortés
entries.summary: Hernán Cortés was a Spanish conquistador and a powerful Seeker who conquered the Aztecs. During his travels he came into possession of the Legendary Titan of Dimensions, Umbra the Shadow Jaguar, which he sealed away in a huge underwater vault.

entries.title: Mirram
entries.summary: Mirram is a Meso-Titan whose appearance is similar to a kangaroo. These unsleeping Titans reside in Australia around Ayer's Rock.

entries.title: Heirospecter
entries.summary: Heirospecter is a dark, ghostly Hecto-Titan whose unearthly body bears gold-trimmed armor with a red gem at its center.

entries.title: Mason
entries.summary: Mason is a Litho-Titan who is a torso that moves via self-propulsion. His body is made up of stone bricks, and his arm is capable of firing energy blasts.

entries.title: Huntik.com/Secret Files
entries.summary:
__NOTOC__

Secret Files were made available to users who registered an account at Huntik.com. These Secret Files give insight into different aspects of the Huntik world as well as other extras. Passwords were given at the end of every episode, and they were used to unlock extras within the Secret Files.

entries.title: Salamandrake
entries.summary: Salamandrake is a Meso-Titan who appears as a fiery green serpent with red markings on its head and large fangs. It is similar in appearance to and has the same base stats as Dambala.

entries.title: Akamaru
entries.summary: Akamaru is a Meso-Titan whose appearance is that of a snake-man, similar to that of Venomaster and Unnamed Titan 011.

entries.title: Stone Sage
entries.summary: Stone Sage is a Krono-Titan whose appearance is that of a grey stone humanoid that can manifest from stone walls. A Stone Sage's Amulet is in the possession of Lok Lambert.

entries.summary: The Cloisters were a Casterwill base in New York were Focauld Casterwill guarded the secrets of the Casterwill family. The base was disguised under the front of a museum to allow Focauld to remain in hiding from the Blood Spiral.

entries.title: Huntik International HQ
entries.summary: Huntik International HQ is the main headquarters of the Huntik Foundation where the Huntik Foundation Council meets to discuss the progress and problems of the Seeker world. This base is located in Manhattan, New York.

entries.summary: The trap located in Basilisk House consisted of a large stone carving of King Basilisk, with its head blocked by a curtain. Pulling back the curtain and looking into the carving's eyes unleashed a purple energy that petrifies its victim. This trap was used to guard the resting place of King Basilisk.

entries.summary: Oceankind is a spell that allows the user to breathe underwater and greatly enhances their ability to swim, making them almost as fast as a fish. The spell also drastically changes the user's appearance for the aquatic environment, but will wear off once the user is no longer submerged.

entries.title: Dopplemorph

entries.title: Power Amplifier

As its name suggests, it amplifies the power of normal Seeker spells - due to its bulk however, it is only employed on certain aircraft, notably the Huntik Foundation's Scramjets, making up for their lack of heavy weaponry.

entries.title: Scramjet
entries.summary: Scramjets are super sleek blue jets used by the Huntik Foundation that are equipped with magical weaponry. Their speed allows them to be anywhere in the world in less than four hours whilst they are armed with Power Amplifiers which make up for their lack of heavy weaponry.

entries.title: The Oracle
entries.summary: The Oracle was a wise man suffering from an unspecified magical curse who was residing in a cave with Lich, deep underground near the Greek coast. He had considerable knowledge on the whereabouts of Atlantis.

entries.title: King Solomon's mines
entries.summary: King Solomon's mines is a gold mine located in a remote area in the Central desert of Ethiopia given to King Solomon by the Queen of Sheba and the resting place of Tao, the Titan of Spirit. Much of the interior was lavishly decorated with gold and blue decor while the surface entrance was a large Golden Asp.

entries.title: Queen of Sheba
entries.summary: Queen of Sheba was an ancient Seeker who reigned in Ethiopia. She had a forbidden romance after falling in love with King Solomon but the pair could never be together.

entries.title: King Solomon
entries.summary: King Solomon was an ancient Seeker who fell in love with the Queen of Sheba but the pair could never be together due to their cultural differences. He possessed many treasures and limitless gold, including the Ring of Tao, and hid them in the gold mines of Ophir given to him by Sheba.

entries.title: Temple of Tecobai
entries.summary: The Temple of Tecobai was a lost monument located deep in the Ecuadorian Jungle across a canyon of liquid hot magma. The surrounding forest was inhabited by hostile Ecuadorian natives.

entries.title: Ecuadorian natives
entries.summary: The Equadorian natives were a tribe who inhabited the Ecuadorian jungle. They watched over the lost Temple of Tecobai and were typically hostile and aggressive towards strangers.

entries.title: Post Street Museum
entries.summary: The Post Street Museum is a museum located in London, England and the base of operations for Montehue and his assistant, Tersly. The museum holds an impressive collection of historical treasures ranging from artworks to artifacts.

entries.title: Nefertiti
entries.summary: Nefertiti was an ancient Egyptian Queen and Seeker, stepmother and adviser to Tutankhamun. She was highly intelligent and a great manipulator and possessed a sceptre containing the power Neverlost and a key that unlocked the Tomb of Tutankhamun. The Tomb of Nefertiti is located in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt.

entries.title: Golden Fleece
entries.summary: The Golden Fleece was an ancient artifact that was sought after by Jason and his Argonauts throughout his quest. The fleece remained in the Argo just off the shores of Sutos.

entries.title: Apple of Paris
entries.summary: The Apple of Paris was an ancient artifact that inspired the Greek myth, the Judgement of Paris. At some point it was obtained by Jason and the Argonauts and resided on the Argo after it was sunk just off the shores of Sutos.

entries.title: Hercules' Arrow
entries.summary: Hercules' Arrow was an ancient artifact that resided on the Argo after it was sunk just off the shores of Sutos.

entries.title: Dragon's teeth
entries.summary: The Dargon's teeth were planted Jason on his quest to find the Golden Fleece and grew into Hoplite Titans. The teeth remained in a chest of Hoplite Amulets before eventually being by recovered Zhalia Moon for the Huntik Foundation.

entries.title: Atalanta
entries.summary: Atalanta was one of the bravest Argonauts who accompanied Jason on his quest to find the Golden Fleece. Her ship was sunk in the Stavropolous River in Velo, Greece. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

entries.title: Ndego Bridge
entries.summary: The Ndego Bridge was a large rope bridge over a stream of water situated on the outskirts of Mek'ele, Ethiopia, a short drive away from Otto's house. Whilst being pursued by Rassimov's Suits in a car, Dante Vale invoked Metagolem from the roof of Otto's car who demolished the bridge, sending the Organization into the water below. [The Golden Asp]

entries.title: Jason's logbook
entries.summary: Jason's logbook was a large book used by Jason which mapped and detailed the adventures of the Argonauts on their quest to find the Golden Fleece.

entries.title: Nostradamus' Scrying Glass
entries.summary: Nostradamus' Scrying Glass is an ancient magical scrying glass that supposedly told him the future. It was placed in a wooden chest, concealed by Nostradamus' Casterwill family illusion powers rendering it invisible to the naked eye, and left in the hidden observatory of the Tower of Nostradamus, formerly known as the Seer's Tower.

entries.title: The Mystery of Shadowing
entries.summary: The Mystery of Shadowing is the nineteenth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series. It takes place after Season 2. Although completed and advertised, the issue was cancelled and ultimately never published. A following issue was also pencilled but cancelled.

entries.title: Shadowing
entries.summary: Shadowing is a wild Meso-Titan whose appearance is that of a silhoutte of a large winged humanoid. He was set to appear in "The Mystery of Shadowing", the cancelled 19th issue of the Huntik comics.

entries.title: Lok Lambert
entries.summary: Lok Lambert is the son of legendary Seeker, Eathon Lambert, whose chance discovery of his father's journal changed his life forever. Thrown into the magical world of Seekers and Titans, Lok gained the help of his classmate, Sophie Casterwill, and Dante Vale, the master Seeker who would become his friend and mentor. Together, they embarked on a quest to find the ancient Amulet of Will before the ev

entries.title: Huntik Foundation
entries.summary: The Huntik Foundation is a loosely organized confederation of philanthropists, adventurers, and historians, dedicated to protecting history and exploring ancient secrets. Understanding the importance of preserving forgotten traditions and cultures, the Foundation's goal is to uncover the lost Titans so as to prevent them from falling into the hands of evil, and to defend the world against the evil

entries.title: Uncover the Location of Void
entries.summary: Uncover the Location of Void was a mission led by Sophie Casterwill and Lok Lambert, aided by Zhalia Moon and Dante Vale, to prove themselves to Lucas Casterwill. They acheived the mission by breaking into the Organization safehouse on the Road of Alchemists and, after being taken prisoner, tricking Wilder into revealing the location of Void at Klaus' bookshop. Lok, Sophie and Cherit were then res

entries.title: The Organization
entries.summary: The Organization, which was founded in 1959, is a ruthless group of Seekers with operatives in every government on the globe, and is one of the primary adversaries of the Huntik Foundation. The Organization's goal is to dominate the world through subterfuge, strong-arm tactics, and raw, brutal power.

entries.title: Amulets
entries.summary: Amulets are the most common artifact containing Titans, the other primary medium being the more-powerful rings. Amulets are usually shaped with a reference to its Titan or the Titan's icon. A jewel is set in its center, which has a color corresponding to the type of the Titan inside. Amulets also anchor a Titan to Earth, allowing them to cross over from the Spirit World known as Huntik.

entries.title: Seekers
entries.summary: Seekers are people who can control Titans or utilize magic. Once a Seeker has bonded with a Titan's Amulet or Ring, that Titan can be summoned to fight at that Seeker’s side. Seekers who have collected Amulets can also learn how to use magical powers that make them stronger than any regular human. When a Seeker bonds with a Titan, they are capable of summoning that Titan for as long as they posses

entries.title: Zhalia Moon
entries.summary: Zhalia Moon is an orphan with a dark past who was raised by Klaus in the Organization. A trained spy and master of disguise, she used her skills for both the Organization and for the Huntik Foundation, eventually choosing to ally herself with her newfound friends in the Foundation. Initially an elegant lone wolf, she found her place to belong among these friends. Her primary Titan is Gareon, a Tit

entries.title: Huntik Foundation Dutch HQ
entries.summary: The Huntik Foundation Dutch HQ is the main base and safehouse for the Huntik Foundation in Rotterdam, Netherlands where it is hidden deep in the city, near the Erasmus Bridge.

entries.title: Breaker
entries.summary: Breaker is one of the most powerful Titans in the Organization. He is a massive, four-armed bear with ancient, tribal markings on his body. Even a single moment of distraction can prove deadly against this traditional fighting Titan. He fights furiously for his master, Grier.

entries.title: Breakspell
entries.summary: Breakspell is a spell used for breaking various enchantments, seals and illusions. This spell shoots a blue beam at the source of magical energy. If the enchantment is too strong, then it will only be temporarily broken. Some enchantments may be so strong as to render Breakspell futile against them.

entries.title: Boltflare
entries.summary:
Boltflare is a basic spell that creates a sphere of bright orange energy which can be used both as a candlelight or as an offensive magical blast. For many Seekers, it is one of the first powers they learn.

An extremely versatile spell, Boltflare is extremely hot, enough to melt a brass doorknob, [S1E16] and can float around on its own above the caster, acting as a source of light in dark locatio

entries.title: Hyperstride
entries.summary: Hyperstride is a basic spell and considered to be mandatory for Seekers. The spell increases the casters speed and agility allowing them to run quickly for escapes and to strike quickly while in combat. As a result, this spell can also increase the distance that the caster can jump. The spell manifests itself as a blue aura that surrounds the casters legs.

entries.title: Augerfrost
entries.summary: Augerfrost is an offensive spell mainly used by the Organization. It creates a sphere of blue, icy energy which can be fired with great force at an enemy. The spell is a staple of the Organization's Suits, though has also been used on several occasions by members of the Casterwill family, Huntik Foundation, and Blood Spiral.

entries.title: Dante Vale
entries.summary: Dante Vale, as the top operative of the Huntik Foundation, is an expert treasure hunter, sleuth, and martial artist. Originally acting as a hired detective, he took to leading the team of Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, Zhalia Moon, and later Den Fears on a mission to track down the missing Foundation operative and father of Lok, Eathon Lambert, and to retrieve the Legendary Titans. He has develop

entries.title: Titans
entries.summary: Titans are powerful, ancient beings that were summoned from the Spirit World of Huntik and then sealed away in Amulets by Lord Casterwill centuries ago. His personal Titans, the powerful Legendary Titans, were sealed within rings. Strong Seekers are able to invoke Titans from their Amulets. Titans, by nature, are neutral beings, although they tend to have the personality of their Seekers impressed

entries.title: Thoughtspecter
entries.summary:
Thoughtspecter is an illusory spell. It is used to create illusions, usually replicas of humans or Titans to cover for an escape or to distract an opponent.

The spell is similar to the illusory abilities of Madea.

entries.title: Darkwave
entries.summary:
Darkwave is a spell that creates a stream of black waves that cause significant damage to the target. Though primarily used by the Blood Spiral, a number of the Organization's Suits have been taught the spell.

According to the Suit Handbook, Darkwave is dangerous to use while chasing a target as one's feet would not be firmly planted. [LGS-078]

This spell is similar to the Bladestorm and Bladewa

entries.title: Everfight
entries.summary: Everfight is a spell which allows the caster to partially heal themselves. The spell manifests itself as an amber aura surrounding the Seeker.

entries.title: Dragonfist
entries.summary: Dragonfist is a spell that amplifies the power of a hand movement through a bright red (or rarely green) aura surrounding the hand. Though generally used for punching, this spell can also be used in conjunction with weapons or objects.

entries.title: Featherdrop
entries.summary: Featherdrop is a spell used to slow down fast falling objects by creating a yellow or red bubble of energy.

entries.title: Bubblelift
entries.summary: Bubblelift is a spell that allows the casting Seeker to create a blue bubble around an object and then lift it into the air. The spell is useful for moving heavy objects or for isolating Titans or other people. This bubble, however, can be popped easily by attacks from outside.

entries.title: Cherit
entries.summary: Cherit is a unique Titan known to Seekers. By some unknown accident or genius operation, his essence became separated from his Amulet thousands of years ago. Unlike his other Titan cousins, Cherit is always invoked and somehow manages to stay anchored to our reality despite the separation from his Amulet. Another result of this separation is Cherit's ability to communicate in human language. He is

entries.title: Fog Monster
entries.summary: The Fog Monsters are ghostly incantations made up of smoke that are conjured by the Blood Spiral master, Tantras, to train his new recruits in mastering their Titans in combat.

entries.title: Erasmus Bridge
entries.summary: The Erasmus Bridge is a large cable-stayed bridge over a stream of water located in the centre of Rotterdam, Netherlands, next to the Huntik Foundation Dutch HQ.

entries.title: Sophie Casterwill
entries.summary: Sophie Casterwill is a daughter of the noble Casterwill family order, who was orphaned as a young girl following a fire at her parents' home. A brilliant student who loves reading, Sophie has a deep knowledge of ancient history, and an excellent memory for myths and legends. Pulled into a life of adventuring with the Huntik Foundation after she forged an alliance with her classmate, Lok Lambert, S

entries.title: Grier
entries.summary: Grier, born Prince Zan-Grier of Sutos Island, served as DeFoe’s right-hand man. Rarely speaking, he presented himself an ordinary thug, but he carries himself with a subtle nobility with his loyalty. Grier once believed that with the Organization’s domination, there would come universal order to keep all people in line and prevent wars. After taking his rightful place as the prince of Sutos, he la

entries.title: DeFoe
entries.summary: DeFoe was a scheming, self-proclaimed mastermind. He lead a small force for the Organization alongside his right-hand man, Grier, under orders to track down a journal in Lok’s possession and to halt the actions of the Huntik Foundation against them. He would stop at nothing to see that his missions were completed, although sometimes this meant putting his own men in peril to do so.

entries.title: Spiral Demon
entries.summary: The Spiral Demons were magical constructs concocted by Arc, the Legendary Titan of Fate, in Sophie Casterwill's dream, to attack the Casterwill family. As minions of the Betrayer, these insidious monsters appear to be grotesque hybrids of the Marauder and Black Scarabese Titans.

entries.title: Suits
entries.summary: Suits are the lowest level minions of the Organization. Typically dressed in dark suits, they are the pawns whom the higher-level Organization operatives use to achieve their nefarious goals.

entries.title: The Professor
entries.summary: Simon Judeau, otherwise known as the Professor, was the cruel and devious founder of the Organization and one of the most powerful Seekers to walk the earth. The Professor was motivated by the desire to heal himself of a curse in conjunction to his past with Metz, Dante Vale, and father of Lok Lambert, the famous and legendary Seeker, Eathon Lambert. The Professor's signature Titan was Araknos, th

entries.title: Santiago
entries.summary: Santiago is Sophie Casterwill's bodyguard and beloved guardian. He is eight years older than Sophie, and saved her life when her house in Paris was set on fire. His family is from Madrid, Spain. A man of few words, Santiago is a master of stealth and agility.

entries.title: LeBlanche
entries.summary: LeBlanche is Sophie Casterwill's beloved guardian, butler, servant, and according to her, attendant. Prim and proper, LeBlanche raised Sophie, ensuring her education and safety, whilst keeping the Casterwill townhouse in order.

entries.title: Rue Guardians
entries.summary: The Rue Guardians are a mysterious order of Seekers from the Casterwill family, who protect the family using ancient magic and curses. There are five Rue Guardians, with the Elder Rue Guardian serving as the leader of the other four.

entries.title: Marc Thompson
entries.summary: Marc Thompson is an American voice actor who voiced Dante Vale, Stack and Cherit in the English dub of Seasons 1 and 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Kirk Thornton
entries.summary: Kirk Thornton is an American voice actor who voiced DeFoe in the English dub of Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Medusa's Island
entries.summary: Medusa's Island is an island located in the Aegean Sea. The Medusa's Cave is hidden here which, for many years, was home to the Titan Medusa.

entries.title: Medusa's Cave
entries.summary: The Medusa's Cave is a large cavern hidden away on Medusa's Island. For many years, the cave was home to the deadly Titan Medusa and a large sculpture of the Gorgon sisters which could invoke the Titan.

entries.title: Runamok
entries.summary: Runamok is a Blood Spiral spell that produces a dazzlingly bright flare of crackling orange light whilst also emitting a sonic wave similar to Clatterbang, disorientating its target.

entries.title: Eathon Lambert
entries.summary: Eathon Lambert is a legendary Seeker and member of the Huntik Foundation. He is also the father of Kathy and Lok Lambert. Though he has been missing for a decade, he is still alive in the Spirit World of Huntik. His journal was found by Lok and Sophie Casterwill. His signature Titan is Jirwolf, but what happened to it is unknown.

entries.title: Guggenheim
entries.summary: Guggenheim is a top operative of the Huntik Foundation. As a senior coordinator, he assigns missions to the Seekers such as Dante Vale, Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill. Guggenheim also answers their questions about the missions and what their objectives are.

entries.title: Peter
entries.summary: Peter is a member of the Huntik Foundation who lives in France. As he is simply a researcher and guide, he does not display any Seeker abilities, nevertheless Peter has the courage to act and help others regardless of the situation.

entries.title: Rassimov
entries.summary: Rassimov was the leader of the Blood Spiral and was a terrifyingly powerful and cunning Seeker. For years, he worked undercover as the Professor's lackey in order to weaken the Organization from the inside, all the while following the orders of the Betrayer in their plan to call back the Nullifiers to Earth and wipe out all life.

entries.title: Raypulse
entries.summary: Raypulse is a basic spell that manifests as a bolt of electrical energy that can be fired from the hands of the caster. The nature of this spell permits it to rebound off of reflective surfaces.

entries.title: Touchram
entries.summary: Touchram is a basic Seeker power that produces a crackling green energy that can be directed at a target. The concussive force can be used to repulse the target to create more distance.

entries.title: Rippleburst
entries.summary: Rippleburst is a high-power spell that creates a powerful stream of yellow energy. This spell is so powerful that it can be used to heavily damage and defeat Titans such as Sabriel.

entries.title: Honorguard
entries.summary: Honorguard is a defensive spell created by the Casterwill family. It manifests as a spherical barrier of orange and/or pink energy to defend against attacks. This spell is often used by members of the Casterwill family.

entries.title: Armorbrand
entries.summary: Armorbrand is a shielding spell that manifests as a spherical barrier of indigo energy to defend against enemy attacks. This spell is a preferred defensive spell of both Zhalia Moon and Simon Judeau.

entries.title: Redcap
entries.summary: Redcap Amulets are one of the most common and important pieces of equipment assigned to Organization Suits. Powerful yet easy to control, Redcap makes the perfect first Titan for devoted Suit operatives. Redcap is an intimidating storm of claws and teeth, muscle and bone. His red eyes, which are covered by a futuristic visor, strike fear into the enemies of the Organization, and his presence alone

entries.title: Mindrone
entries.summary: Mindrone is a bipedal Swara-Titan with a prominent, single red eye taking the place of its face and two wiry appendages protruding from its back. Mindrone is related to the power-equivalent Terrapede Titans and to the weaker Enforcer Titans. As this sadistic Titan enjoys making people suffer, Mindrone as well as its related Titans are commonly used by the Suits of the evil Organization for both co

entries.title: Higgans
entries.summary: Higgans is a member of the Huntik Foundation Council who appears to be of Asian descent. He currently quarters in Huntik International HQ in New York City whilst also coordinating his own group of Foundation Seekers.

entries.title: Caliban
entries.summary: Caliban is a powerful and rare Meso-Titan who possesses the fury of an Aztec warrior. This masked warrior, like the lion, represented power and fierceness to the Aztec people. Due to Caliban's strong will, only a very strong and talented Seeker can bond with this Titan. Caliban is closely related to the Caliban Ocean Warrior Titans used by the Casterwill family.

entries.title: Cú Chulainn
entries.summary: Cú Chulainn, the great Dog Warrior, was a powerful ancient Seeker from Ireland who featured in many Irish myths. He was buried at the Newgrange Passage Tomb along with his Gybolg Amulet.

entries.title: Kyojin
entries.summary: Kyojin is a giant Yama-Titan who guards the island of Yonaguni in Japan, sleeping on the bed of the ocean. It has a distinctive robotic appearance with silver armor whilst taking the appearance of an enormous dogū statue.

entries.title: Freelancer
entries.summary: Freelancer is a loyal knight who is happy to serve a Seeker with a noble heart. He bears a prominent lance with his dominant arm and a shield with his other arm. Due to the ease of bonding to and summoning this Titan, he is often the first Titan of many novice Seekers. This trend is because Freelancer does not care who asks him for help and is ready to jump into any battle. It has been a loyal Tit

entries.title: Magicnet
entries.summary: Magicnet is a spell that traps an opponent in a net of blue energy. This confinement can then be transported via magic and is very difficult to escape from.

entries.title: Geisha
entries.summary: Geisha is a Yama-Titan who has the appearance of a traditional Geisha entertainer. Much like the Titan Fan Dancer, she fights with a pair of Japanese war fans. Her Amulet was in the possession of Bonnie, a minion of Professor Rickman.

entries.title: Red Vampress
entries.summary: Red Vampress is a blue-skinned Draco-Titan. Like her vampiric name suggests, she dons a high-collared red and black vampire's cloak. Her Amulet is in the possession of Celina, a minion of Professor Rickman.

entries.title: Mercenary Recruit
entries.summary: The Mercenary Recruit is a hired Seeker who was swiftly recruited by DeFoe to join the Organization.

entries.title: Breaker Cub
entries.summary: Breaker Cub is a Meso-Titan and a smaller "teen" version of the powerful Breaker Titans. Like Breaker, it has the appearance of a four-armed bear with traditional tribal armor and markings decorating its body.

entries.title: Lich
entries.summary: Lich is a Krono-Titan whose appearance is that of a decayed skeleton of a Greek soldier. Lich is known to be the guardian of the tombs, notably the Tomb of the Undead.

entries.title: Solwing
entries.summary: Solwing is a Krono-Titan resembling a six-winged hawk wearing the helmet of a Greek or Roman soldier. Being highly adept at flight, Solwing can dive at incredible velocity and turn just moments before impact with the ground, a building, or another Titan. A faithful Titan to Dante Vale, Solwing's effectiveness to Seekers stretches from ancient history into the modern age as he fights alongside the

entries.title: Bales
entries.summary: Bales is an Organization operative, renowned for being something of a "smooth operator". Wearing a blue flat-cap and grey blazer, he is far more discreet and inconspicuous than the average Suit.

entries.title: Sabriel
entries.summary: Sabriel is swift, fearless, and will do anything to protect her Seeker. Coupled with her ability to bounce back instantly from most battles, she is a dangerous opponent. Sophie Casterwill's faithful fighter, Sabriel is among the toughest and most loyal Titans available to Seekers. Her sister is the magic-oriented Sorcerel.

entries.title: Alexander the Great
entries.summary: Alexander the Great was a Seeker and ancient Greek king who founded the coastal city of Alexandria during his numerous conquests.

entries.title: Defend The Cloisters
entries.summary: Defend The Cloisters was a mission assigned to Dante Vale, Den Fears, Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill by Metz. They were sent to rescue Focauld Casterwill at The Cloisters whilst on vacation in New York, USA. They were nearly defeated by Kiel and his men, but thanks to Sophie's quick-thinking to focus the Power Amplifier of the Huntik Foundation jet on the base, the team were able to escape with

entries.title: Kreutalk
entries.summary: Kreutalk is a Swara-Titan that looks like a flying manta ray with the venom of a cobra. Although manta rays are curious, and usually peaceful creatures, Kreutalk is cruel, aggressive and unpredictable.  It can spit acid strong enough to dissolve metal. Kreutalk is a fairly unusual Titan, with very few copies known to exist in the modern world.

entries.title: Kipperin
entries.summary: Kipperin is a helpful moth-like Gaia-Titan and the primary Titan of Lok Lambert. He's not quite as fast as Icarus, but he is strong enough to carry people or even large Titans. Lok has the same Kipperin that his father had, when he found Eathon's Kipperin Amulet alongside Eathon Lambert's journal. Kipperin is friendly, and is often eager to help out Seekers that have bonded with him, whether that

entries.title: Huntik 5D
entries.summary: Huntik 5D is an interactive dark ride based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, located at the Magicland theme park (formerly Rainbow Magicland) which opened in Rome in 2011. The ride features an animated CGI story featuring the Huntik characters in 3D. It was produced by a collaboration of several companies, including Rainbow, Rainbow CGI, Alterface, Art Project, Vida Studio, Sample, Hytechnology and A

entries.title: Gareon
entries.summary: Gareon is a lizard-like Titan that can stick to walls like a gecko and whose camouflage abilities far surpass those of a chameleon. Due to his ability to become invisible, Gareon is regularly used to cross enemy lines and report back with valuable information. Gareon Amulets are in the possession of a number of Seekers, including Zhalia Moon and Suits of the Organization.

entries.title: Lodestone
entries.summary: The Lodestone is an ancient three-sided stone that can create an anti-magic field to negate magic, preventing the casting of spells and invocation of Titans. It was protected by a defence mechanism in the form of numerous rock-like guardians, controlled and powered by the Lodestone itself.

entries.title: Kilthane
entries.summary: Kilthane, the Black Knight, is utterly loyal to his Seeker and never retreats from battle. He wears a dark, slate-colored suit of armor with blades that resemble insect legs protruding from behind his cape. He bears a curved blade and a shield with a green dragon for a crest. Kilthane Titans are known to be used by Zhalia Moon and Ryder, and they are worthy and mighty allies.

entries.title: Metagolem
entries.summary: Metagolem is an incredibly powerful Titan, but he can be difficult to summon unless his Seeker is in great danger. Confirmed equivalent Titans to Metagolem include the aquatic Coralgolem, the larger Undergolem, the experimental Brahe, and the smaller Chaingolem.

entries.title: Gar-Ghoul
entries.summary: Gar-Ghoul is a powerful and fearsome Titan and was the basis for the gargoyle statues and legends of France. As Gar-Ghoul could strike fear into other evil creatures, statues imitating Gar-Ghoul were built and placed on many French buildings to ward off evil spirits.

entries.title: Strix
entries.summary: Strix are pesky, mosquito-like Swara-Titans. These Titans are common and require very little energy for a Seeker to invoke, so they are often summoned in groups of two or three from a single Amulet.

entries.title: Springer
entries.summary: Springer is a cute, fox-like Titan that normally has two tails, but some individuals have three or more tails. Due to their low stats, Springer Titans are not fit for combat but instead excel at sly espionage. They are excellent at solving puzzles, deactivating traps, and getting into tight places.

entries.title: Shinobi
entries.summary: Shinobi is a ninja-like Yama-Titan whose exceptional stealth is heightened by his shadowy abilities. Shinobi's Amulet is the possession of Santiago.

entries.title: Simone Borselli
entries.summary: Simone Borselli is the creative director and assistant director of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. As the artistic director, he was responsible for many of the original designs for the series.

entries.title: Karen Strassman
entries.summary: Karen Strassman is an American actress who voiced Zhalia Moon in Seasons 1 and 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Grant George
entries.summary: Grant George is an American voice over artist who voiced Den Fears in Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Fear Monster
entries.summary: The Fear Monsters were blue phantom-like creatures with red eyes, left by the strongest Rue Guardians of ancient times to guard the Legendary Titan of Valor, Mythras, as part of the Casterwill family's Trial of Courage in which a noble would make a claim for leadership of the Casterwill elders. Concocted entirely from fear, these wraithlike beings cannot be defeated by direct attacks and will grow

entries.title: Giochi Preziosi
entries.summary: Giochi Preziosi is an Italian toy company that oversaw the creation and distribution of merchandise for Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers in Europe and Russia in 2011. Their toys included a range of miniature figures, Amulet launchers, 15cm Action figures and an Interactive Willblade roleplay sword.

entries.title: Upper Deck
entries.summary: Upper Deck is a private American company that specialises in the production and distribution of Trading cards. In 2009, Upper Deck oversaw the release of the Huntik Trading Card Game releasing three sets across the year. That same year, the company also released a range of toys which included several fully articulated action figures for Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The following year, du

entries.title: A Seeker Is Born
entries.summary: A boy named Lok Lambert stumbles upon the ancient and secret world of Seekers after finding his father's journal and an Amulet. An evil group known as the Organization takes interest and tries to take the journal by force. Urged by his friend and fellow Seeker, Sophie Casterwill, Lok seeks the help of Dante Vale. However, in the chase, the journal becomes ruined, and the Organization surrounds the

entries.title: Kyroptero
entries.summary: Kyroptero is a Litho-Titan that blends perfectly with the stone stalactites hanging from the ceilings of caves. Sometimes this Titan hides so well that he doesn't move for hours at a time.

entries.title: Riverjaw
entries.summary: Riverjaw is a Meso-Titan that resembles a green-skinned crocodile whose body is garnished in jewelry and carvings that symbolize her Aztec heritage.

entries.title: Ferryman
entries.summary: Ferryman is a white, jackal-like Hecto-Titan. Ferryman wears bandages and orange, Egyptian-style clothing. This Titan serves as a means of transportation between Earth and the Spirit World.

entries.title: Iginio Straffi
entries.summary:
Iginio Straffi is the founder and president of the Rainbow S.p.A. studio, which he jointly owns with the American company ViacomCBS. He is the creator and director of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. [Wikipedia]

In creating the show, Iginio Straffi stated that his goal was to create a "cultured alternative to Japanese manga and American cartoons, giving viewers the opportunity to learn about Italian an

entries.title: Friendface
entries.summary: Friendface is a spell that allows the casting Seeker to take on the appearance of an enemies friend in order to infiltrate their ranks or to confuse an opponent in battle.

entries.title: The Legend of the Gargoyle
entries.summary: The Legend of the Gargoyle was a mission that Dante Vale received from Guggenheim. Sophie Casterwill convinced him to turn it into a team effort so that she and Lok Lambert could accompany him for Foundation training. The team's mission was to unveil the myth of the Cave of the Gargoyle located on the Seine River in Rouen, France. They then needed to obtain the Titan Gar-Ghoul. The mission was ult

entries.title: The Mystery of the Paris Catacombs
entries.summary: The Mystery of the Paris Catacombs was a Huntik Foundation mission assigned to Dante Vale, Zhalia Moon, Lok Lambert, and Sophie Casterwill by Guggenheim. The primary objective was to find and retrieve the Ring of Arc. The mission was completed successfully and was then continued into the next mission, Joan of Arc's Ring.

entries.title: Joan of Arc
entries.summary: Joan of Arc (Jeanne d'Arc in French) was an ancient Seeker who lived in France during the 1400s. Rumor has it that her abilities were inherited from her French royal ancestors, although she was in reality born among peasants. She was plagued with visions of the future since age 12, either due to her magical abilities or the curse placed on the Ring of Arc that she used.

entries.title: Cave of the Gargoyle
entries.summary: The Cave of the Gargoyle is located in a remote portion of the Catacombs in Rouen, France. The Cave is only accessible from the Seine River in France, and the entrance was protected by a statue of a Gargoyle. The statue was a magical trap that projected highly-pressurized blasts of water out of its mouth. Underneath the main chamber was a secret base used by ancient Seekers, most notably by Joan o

entries.title: Darkvoid
entries.summary: Darkvoid is a powerful Blood Spiral spell used by Rassimov that forms an abyss underneath the target that can disintegrate anything beyond the event horizon in mere seconds. The extent of the spell can be as local as an individual item or as extensive as an entire room. A similar spell, Abyssalfall, is used by the Casterwill Hunters.

entries.title: Findshape
entries.summary:
Findshape is a Casterwill spell that repairs objects that have been damaged or destroyed. More complex objects often take greater amounts of concentration to repair.

The spell manifested itself as a violet aura on the object itself the first time, then as a yellow stream travelling toward its target every other time.

entries.title: Nimblefire
entries.summary: Nimblefire is a spell that grants the caster super speed for a short time in a similar manner to the spells Hyperstride and Shadowspeed. The spell is manifested as an orange energy and often is concentrated on the legs.

entries.title: Shadowspeed
entries.summary: Shadowspeed is a spell which allows the caster to move at extreme speeds for a few seconds. A similar spell to Nimblefire, Shadowspeed is used for quick bursts of speed as opposed to prolonged speed. It is commonly associated with members of the Organization.

entries.title: Amulet of Will
entries.summary:
The Amulet of Will is a powerful artifact once used by Lord Casterwill and alluded to in the journal of Eathon Lambert. It has become the symbol of the Casterwill family, decorating their artifacts and landmarks. [The Phoenix's Ashes]

Legend states that anyone attempting to summon either of the three Legendary Titans, Araknos, Behemoth, or Tao, without bearing the Amulet of Will, will be afflicte

entries.summary:
__NOTOC__

Huntik.com is the official website for the show Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The website was removed around the end of 2010, after which the site was redirected to huntik.it Old sections of the Huntik.com website are included here for archival purposes.

entries.title: Tao
entries.summary: Tao is the Legendary Titan of Spirit and is a tall, ghostly being that floats on top of a cloud of energy. He possesses blue, liquid-like skin that can turn into vapor. The gem on its forehead and the gown around his waist grant this human-like Titan a regal appearance.

entries.title: Spirit World
entries.summary: The Spirit World, or Huntik, is the dimension from which the Titans and the Nullifiers originated. When a Titan's Amulet is permanently destroyed, the Titan is banished back to Huntik. If a Titan remains out of its Amulet when its Seeker dies, if and the Titan runs out of energy, the Titan may also be returned to the Spirit World. The primary remaining means of bridging between Huntik and Earth ar

entries.title: Nullifiers
entries.summary: The Nullifiers are a group of unimaginably powerful and evil beings from Huntik that Lord Casterwill and the Titans fought for 500 years. Their presence brought destruction to the world.

entries.title: Behemoth
entries.summary: Behemoth, the Legendary Titan of Body, wields more pure physical strength than any other Titan commonly known to Seekers. The one-ton stone globe that Behemoth carries on his back is used as both a weapon and to intimidate his enemies.

entries.title: Enderflame
entries.summary: Enderflame is a powerful spell that serves as a magical flamethrower. This spell manifests itself as an orange fire that extends from the caster's hand.

entries.title: Feyone
entries.summary: Feyone is a Celtic-Irish warrior like Gybolg. Seekers in old Ireland used Feyone Titans to break through lines of enemy warriors so they could challenge the leaders directly. She is commonly invoked alongside Icarus.

entries.title: Hydramaskar
entries.summary: Hydramaskar is a Meso-Titan, with three heads, each donning a bizarre totem-like face which protrude from its draconic body via long serpentine necks. A three-headed relation to the seven-headed Hydra, this Aztec Titan is a formidable opponent.

entries.title: Jeweled Colossus
entries.summary: Jeweled Colossus is a Litho-Titan whose body is covered in armor and in green and purple gems. These gems give his body extra durability in battle.

entries.title: Jokoul
entries.summary: Jokoul are Litho-Titans that resemble devious ice trolls of Nordic regions. These gray-skinned Titans attack through physical combat using their horns and armored claws. As a large stash of Jokoul Amulets was uncovered by Simon Judeau, these Titans are often used by members of the Organization.

entries.title: Skingrip
entries.summary: Skingrip is a spell that restricts the movement of the enemy. The target is wrapped from head to toe in a yellow, mummy cloth-like energy that can temporarily ensnare and halt the opponent. If the target is experienced with spells or possesses great physical strength, it is possible for the bonds to be broken.

entries.title: Newlife
entries.summary: Newlife is a spell used by members of the Casterwill family to revive Titans that have already been defeated in battle, giving the Titans a second chance to fight.

entries.title: Wolf Knight
entries.summary: Wolf Knight Titans demonstrate that not all werewolves are simply evil, savage monsters. The Wolf Knight is a noble Titan that is gentle around children and animals yet fierce in the heat of battle. Unlike many other wolf Titans, such as Fenris, Wolf Knight has not fallen into the hands of evil Seekers but has instead been used on the side of good.

entries.title: Riderless Chariot
entries.summary: The Riderless Chariot is a blue Krono-Titan chariot driven by two blazing, yellow horses. It is a fast Titan with a will of its own, and it has a tendency to rush forward to crash into its enemies.

entries.title: Peque
entries.summary: Peque is a red-skinned Meso-Titan healer who is linked with the Mayan people of Central America. She wears an intricate Mayan mask over her face as well as jewelry on her neck, wrists, and ankles.

entries.title: Anubian
entries.summary: Anubian, the Scarab Lord, is a powerful and unusual Titan, Anubian is formed by calling together the Black Scarabese and Gold Scarabese Titans. A Seeker must have enough power and control to command all five Titans to form Anubian.

entries.title: Albion
entries.summary: Albion the Dragon Slayer is a Titan with a largely human appearance having gray armor, blue hair, and pale skin. His weapon is a golden sword which is attached to his armor by a energy thread. He is an immensely loyal Titan who can resist attempts at mind-control. This Titan was lent to Sophie by her butler, LeBlanche, in order to aid her in the coming battle against the Professor before being ret

entries.title: Eathon Lambert's journal
entries.summary: Eathon Lambert's Journal is a collection of Eathon Lambert's knowledge about being a Seeker and of ancient secrets about Titans and magic. Lok Lambert has used this journal written by his father in an attempt to uncover the truth behind Eathon's disappearance at the hands of the Professor.

entries.title: Huntik Trading Card Game
entries.summary: The Huntik Trading Card Game (TCG) is a two-player trading card game based upon the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers television series. The cards, which are collected randomly by players and assembled into 40-card decks, represent various Seekers, Titans, and spells from the world of Huntik. The game was published by Upper Deck Entertainment in Europe and the United States and launched on February 17, 20

entries.title: Overlos
entries.summary: Overlos is the Legendary Titan of Immortality and is the most powerful known Titan. It is a large Titan with six eyes, a flaming head, golden armor, a shield resembling the Amulet of Will, a spear, and wings. This Legendary Titan can only be invoked in a ritual involving Araknos, Behemoth, and Tao.

entries.title: Araknos
entries.summary: Araknos is the Legendary Titan of Mind and was the main source of power for the Organization while bonded to Simon Judeau. While most Titans are found to be most useful fighting on the front lines, Araknos' true power lies in manipulation. Therefore, the Seekers fortunate enough to control Araknos rarely make this public and instead stay in the background, pulling the strings of his will-bending w

entries.title: The Casterwill Client
entries.summary: Sophie Casterwill joins Lok Lambert and Dante Vale in fighting against the Organization. Sophie then hires Dante to uncover the mystery behind the disappearance of Eathon Lambert, Lok's father, and to train herself and Lok. The Seekers and Cherit follow a clue from Eathon Lambert's journal and research the golem. They find references to Jodis Lore, but the Organization is in hot pursuit and also l

entries.title: Mindsight
entries.summary: Mindsight is an illusory spell used by Organization members that allows the target to read an enemy's mind and see their next move.

entries.title: Headcage
entries.summary: Headcage is a spell that the casting Seeker can utilize to protect themselves or another person from a spell or ability that targets their mind, whether it is an attack or another type of mental penetration. The spell takes the form of a green aura which surrounds the head of the target. This aura vanishes after the spell has taken effect.

entries.title: Simplemind
entries.summary: Simplemind is a red-aura mental spell. It is a power of suggestion that manipulates or erases someone's memory. After casting, the Seeker generally dictates the person what they shall forget or believe. Simplemind is primarily effective against weak minds, thus is not very effective against trained Seekers.

entries.title: Ring of Arc
entries.summary: The Ring of Arc is an artifact containing the Legendary Titan of Fate, Arc. Anyone in contact with the ring suffers from intense visions related to that person's fears. The ring was responsible for Joan of Arc's spiritual powers.

entries.title: Cathedral of Notre Dame
entries.summary: The Cathedral of Notre Dame, located in Paris, France, is a National monument and major tourist attraction whilst also serving as a Huntik Foundation base. It proved key to locating the entrance to the Paris Catacombs and the Ring of Arc.

entries.title: Tremayne
entries.summary: Tremayne is a four-armed, green-skinned fairy that is constantly causing mischief. With her dragonfly-like wings, she is easily able to exhaust those who chase her.

entries.title: Gawain
entries.summary: Gawain is a green-skinned and green-haired Gaia-Titan with antler-like tree limbs growing from his head. His armor is made out of wood and green leaves. Gawain was once the primary Titan of the legendary King Arthur.

entries.title: Words of Truth, Heart of Lies
entries.summary: Pursuing clues about Eathon Lambert and the Amulet of Will, Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, and Cherit head to Prague, Czech Republic. They are ambushed by the Organization but are assisted by the mysterious Zhalia Moon, who joins in the investigation of the golem. Though the Organization gain the key, the team is able to make a replica from an imprint. Lok manages to invoke Kipperin a

entries.title: Mr. Abdul
entries.summary: Mr. Abdul is a Suit working for the Organization, previously commanded by Rassimov.

entries.title: Ms. Dread
entries.summary: Ms. Dread is a Suit working for the Organization.

entries.title: Yucatan
entries.summary: Yucatan, originally called Huntik Spillwater, is a water ride based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, located at the Magicland theme park (formerly known as Rainbow Magicland). It opened in Rome in 2011. The ride features several large animatronic Titans, a Mayan temple and two 15 and 25 meter drops. It is one of two Huntik-themed attractions at the park, the other being the Huntik 5D dark ride.

entries.title: Huntik: Titan Defence
entries.summary: Huntik: Titan Defence is an app game based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers released on September 26, 2010. The game features a six-chapter story mode throughout which the player must defend Eathon Lambert's journal from the advancing Titans of the Organization. There is also a challenge mode which enables the player to complete different achievements, and help them unlock new and more powerful Titans

entries.title: Huntik Go
entries.summary: Huntik Go is the opening theme song for Huntik: Secrets & Seekers and is heard at the start of every episode in both seasons of the show. Due to the international broadcast of the series, several different language dubs of the song exist, with the English version being performed by Jeff Washburn. The English version of the song was combined with the Heroes and Titans ending theme and released comm

entries.title: Heroes and Titans
entries.summary: Heroes and Titans is the ending theme for Huntik: Secrets & Seekers and is used during the closing credits of every episode of both seasons of the show. An extended version of the song is also heard several times during the first season, notably during the most atmospheric or dramatic moments. The lyrics are Italian and, unlike those of the Huntik Go opening theme, have not been re-dubbed for any

entries.title: The Amulet Seekers
entries.summary: The Amulet Seekers (titled I Cercatori di Amuleti in Italy) is a novel written by Frank J. Martucci, based on Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. It was published by Fabbri Editori and was released in Italy on November 19, 2008.

entries.title: The City of Atlantis
entries.summary: The City of Atlantis (titled La città di Atlantide in Italy) is a gamebook written by Frank J. Martucci, based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. It was published by Fabbri Editori and released in Italy on November 25, 2009. It was planned to be followed by The Showdown. The story is written from the perspective of Lok Lambert, whose actions along the journey are decided by the reader.

entries.title: Frank J. Martucci
entries.summary: Frank J. Martcucci is an Italian writer who wrote the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers book releases, The Amulet Seekers and The City of Atlantis, and the unpublished books The Blood Spiral and The Showdown.

entries.title: The Blood Spiral (book)
entries.summary: The Blood Spiral (titled La Spirale di Sangue in Italy) was a novel written by Frank J. Martucci based on Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. It had been planned to be published by Fabbri Editori on 1st June 2010 but was ultimately never released.

entries.title: The Showdown
entries.summary: The Showdown (titled La Resa dei Conti in Italy) was the second gamebook based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, following The City of Atlantis. Written by Frank J. Martucci, it was intended to be published by Fabbri Editori on 1st May, 2010, but was ultimately never released.

entries.title: Artbook
entries.summary: The Artbook is a unique book that contains an extensive collection of production art and original designs from Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, ranging from Seekers and Titans, to artifacts and locations. It was printed in 2009 and contains more than 158 pages, written in English and Italian. It was put on display to the general public in 2019 at the Milan Comic Museum as part of 15 Years of

entries.title: Tridimensional
entries.summary: Tridimensional is an Italian publishing company owned by Rainbow that oversaw the production and release of merchandise for Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers in Italy and Europe. Its most notable products include the 2009 Miniatures collection, and the Huntik Magazine comic book series. In Europe, their products were distributed by Panini.

entries.title: Michele Bettali
entries.summary:
Michele Bettali is an Italian musician and one of the three composers of the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers soundtrack, including the songs Huntik Go and Heroes and Titans which were released commercially in 2010.

He has worked alongside Stefano Carrara and Fabrizio Castania on a wide array of projects, including Huntiks sister show, Winx Club.

entries.title: Stefano Carrara
entries.summary:
Stefano Carrara is an Italian musician and one of the three composers of the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers soundtrack, including the songs Huntik Go and Heroes and Titans which were released commercially in 2010.

He has worked alongside Fabrizio Castania and Michele Bettali on many different projects, including Huntiks sister show, Winx Club.

entries.title: Fabrizio Castania
entries.summary:
Fabrizio Castania is an Italian musician and one of the three composers of the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers soundtrack, including the songs Huntik Go and Heroes and Titans which were released commercially in 2010.

He has worked alongside Michele Bettali and Stefano Carrara on many different projects, including Huntiks sister show, Winx Club.

entries.title: Season 1
entries.summary: The first season of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers began airing in the UK and US on January 3rd, 2009, on Jetix and The CW's CW4Kids networks respectively. It premiered in Italy on January 12th, 2009 on the Rai Due network. It follows the adventures of Lok Lambert as he is thrown into the world of Seekers and Titans motivated by the search for his missing father through clues left in his journal, unear

entries.title: Phoenix Volcano
entries.summary: Phoenix Volcano is a large volcano located on an uninhabited Indonesian island. It was the resting place of the Ring of Phoenix, the Legendary Titan of Rebirth, and was protected by an anti-magic field generated by the Lodestone. The interior design was based on that of the Amulet of Will, a symbol of the Casterwill family.

entries.title: Hernán Cortés' vault
entries.summary: Hernán Cortés' vault is a large underwater cave located deep in the Sea of Cortés, also known as the Gulf of California. Spanish conqueror Hernán Cortés buried all of his treasure here, along with the Ring of Umbra, the Legendary Titan of Dimensions, which he had found in the Yucatan. In addition to numerous deadly traps, he left his Titan, Conquistador, to guard the treasures.

entries.title: Lightedge
entries.summary: Lightedge is a unique spell that enhances the offensive power of a weapon. It is favored by Dellix who uses it to amplify the force and velocity of his sword.

entries.title: Annette
entries.summary: Annette is a French Huntik Foundation researcher who works undercover as an assistant at the Tower of Nostradamus alongside Billie and Peter, as part of Nasher's team. Like Peter, she does not display any Seeker abilities, but nevertheless plays a vital role in studying Nostradamus' tower.

entries.summary:

"I've got to call for help! 'Ello? 'Ello? It's an emergency!"

"Our Scramjets - they can be anywhere in world in less than four hours."

entries.title: Nostradamus' Tomb
entries.summary: Nostradamus' Tomb is the resting place of the Casterwill family seer, Nostradamus. It is hidden deep beneath a forest of red-leaved trees in Salon Graveyard and can only be opened by stabbing the Willblade into the ground.

entries.title: Salon Graveyard
entries.summary: Salon Graveyard is a large cemetery located in Salon. Nostradamus' Tomb is located beneath here.
