entries.title: TCG:Starter Deck
entries.summary:
The Starter Deck was a 2-player beginners' expansion pack for Secrets and Seekers, the first set of the Huntik Trading Card Game. The box contained two 30-card decks with two exclusive foil cards, these being Caliban: Dante's Titan and Gar-Ghoul: Gothic Terror.
It also included a 21-card mission pack featuring 7 mission cards, a Mission Map, a Seeker Training Manual, and a bonus DVD consisting of

entries.title: Huntik TCG Tutorial
entries.summary: The Huntik TCG Tutorial is an exclusive minisode of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers that serves as a step by step video guide on how to play the Huntik Trading Card Game. It was released by Upper Deck on the bonus DVD in the Starter Deck.

entries.title: Prophecy or Legend?
entries.summary: Prophecy or Legend? was the third gamebook based on Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, following The Showdown. Based on the second season of the show, it was promoted at the 2012 Bologna Children's Book Fair but ultimately never released.

entries.title: Battle to the End
entries.summary: Battle to the End (titled Machi mechri Telous in Greece) is a 24-page colouring book based on Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. It was published by Modern Times and was released in Greece on January 1, 2010.

entries.title: Sean Molyneaux
entries.summary: Sean Molyneaux is the head writer of Seasons 1 and 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. He also wrote the first twelve stories of the Huntik Magazine comic books.

entries.title: Sea Freelancer
entries.summary: Sea Freelancer is a Krono-Titan used by the Mermen of Atlantis and is the Atlantean equivalent of the Titan Freelancer. Instead of shiny steel, this Titan's shell is made of resistant coral and wields an indestructible-looking spear stained with rust if it has laid at the bottom of the sea for a millenium.

entries.title: Matt Caplan
entries.summary: Matt Caplan is an American actor, singer and voiceover artist who voiced Lok Lambert in Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. In his voiceover work, he is often credited under the name Drew Aaron, as he was for Huntik.

entries.title: Saint George
entries.summary: Saint George was a valiant and noble Seeker who was renowned throughout history for saving the Princess Silene from a great dragon with his lance, Ascalon. His Sword, containing his Titan Lindorm, was buried for centuries in Silene, Libya until it was eventually dug up by the Organization. Both the sword and his lance were later recovered by the Huntik Foundation.

entries.title: Clonemask
entries.summary: Clonemask is a spell that allows a Seeker to create a mask of someone's face to wear as a disguise.

entries.title: Giorgio Salati
entries.summary: Giorgio Salati is a scriptwriter who wrote several of the Huntik Magazine stories alongside Sean Molyneaux.

entries.title: Suits/List of Suits
entries.summary: The following is a list of all known Suits for the Organization. All unnamed Suits are numbered in order of appearance.

entries.title: Emi
entries.summary: Emi is a Seeker working for the Huntik Foundation who carries out research at a university in Naha, Japan. Emi's ancestors were Seekers from the age of the Samurai and she comes from a family of ninjas, so she is an expert in ninjitsu. Den Fears quickly developed a crush on her during their mission to find the Titan Kyojin in Japan.

entries.title: Lee Roy
entries.summary: Lee Roy is a dangerous and powerful Seeker who works for the Organization.

entries.title: Ms. Fitch
entries.summary: Miss Fitch is a member of the Organization and the cold and calculating assistant of Dr. Benway.

entries.title: Maddie Blaustein
entries.summary:
Maddie Blaustein, also known as Kendra Bancroft and Adam Seth Blaustein, was an American voice actress, comic book writer and transgender rights activists who played the role of Rassimov in Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, as well as the role of Meowth in the Pokémon anime series.

Blaustein was born in Long Island, New York on the 9th of October 1960. She was born intersex but assigned male

entries.title: Marc Diraison
entries.summary: Marc Diraison is an American voice actor who played the role of Rassimov in Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. He took over the role from Maddie Blaustein following her death in 2008.

entries.title: Ben Diskin
entries.summary: Ben Diskin is an American voice actor who played the role of Harrison Fears in Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Richard Epcar
entries.summary: Richard Epcar is an American voice actor who played the role of Grier in Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Wayne Grayson
entries.summary: Wayne Grayson is an American actor who played the role of Peter, Otto, Master Storm and numerous Suits and Silent Soldiers in Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Mike Pollock
entries.summary: Mike Pollock is an American actor who voiced The Professor in Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. In Season 2, he voiced White.

entries.title: Jeff Washburn
entries.summary: Jeff Washburn is an American singer who performed the vocals in the English version of the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers theme song, '"Huntik Go".

entries.title: Tutankhamun
entries.summary: Tutankhamun was an ancient Egyptian pharaoh and Seeker, and the stepson of Nefertiti. He possessed a Necklace believed to have belonged to the Betrayer which was buried in his tomb.

entries.title: JB Blanc
entries.summary: Jean-Benoît Blanc is an American actor and director who voiced Klaus in the English dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Squid
entries.summary: A huge squid that lives in the Sea of Cortés was accidentally woken up by Dante Vale while searching for the hidden entrace to Hernán Cortés' vault. Feeling threatened and wanting to defend its home, the squid grabbed Dante who kicked it away and invoked Metagolem, instantly scaring the squid away. [Gremlow Infestation!]

entries.title: Foundation Pilot
entries.summary: An unnamed pilot works for the Huntik Foundation and drives an old and somewhat unstable cargo jet. His job is to transport Seekers and Foundation vehicles to missions around the world.

entries.title: Unnamed Foundation Agent 001
entries.summary: Unnamed Foundation Agent 001 is a Seeker working for the Huntik Foundation. He is a trained field operative and often works with two other unnamed agents, 002 and 003.

entries.title: Unnamed Foundation Agent 002
entries.summary: Unnamed Foundation Agent 002 is a Seeker working for the Huntik Foundation. He is a trained field operative and often works with two other unnamed agents, 001 and 003.

entries.title: Unnamed Foundation Agent 003
entries.summary: Unnamed Foundation Agent 003 is a Seeker working for the Huntik Foundation. He is a trained field operative and often works with two other unnamed agents, 001 and 002.

entries.title: Rotterdam Orphanage
entries.summary: The Rotterdam Orphanage was a children's home in Rotterdam, Netherlands where Zhalia Moon, Den and Harrison Fears grew up. It was a miserable place with poor living conditions, and where systematic bullying and mistreatment was rife among the children who lived there. Harrison described it as a "prison". It was run by its caretaker Ms. Shrodinger until it was taken over by the Blood Spiral in sear

entries.title: Bruno
entries.summary: Bruno is a young orphan with blonde hair and a plump build who lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and became a member of the Blood Spiral.

entries.title: Dirk
entries.summary: Dirk is a young orphan who lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students.

entries.title: Into the River of Secrets
entries.summary: Dante Vale is given the assignment to search for the mysterious Gar-Ghoul Titan, believed to be in Rouen, France, while developing Lok's summoning powers and his use with magical spells.

entries.title: Unnamed Orphan 003
entries.summary: A unnamed orphan with brown hair lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students.

entries.title: Unnamed Orphan 004
entries.summary: A unnamed orphan with shaved brown hair and a plump build lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students.

entries.title: Unnamed Orphan 005
entries.summary: A unnamed orphan with red hair lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students.

entries.title: Crawling the Catacombs
entries.summary: The mystery of Joan of Arc being a former Seeker leads the gang to Notre Dame where a stone gargoyle holds the key to the hidden catacombs entrance and to more Titans.

entries.title: Spiral Bishop
entries.summary: The Spiral Bishop is a mysterious and high-ranking member of the Blood Spiral whose role is that of preserving the historical incantations and traditions of the group.

entries.title: Kopesh
entries.summary: Kopesh is a blue, jackal-like Hecto-Titan. He has sharp, gold claws and has a curved, golden blade protruding from the top of its head. Kopesh wears bandages, a tattered cape and teal clothing with gold trim.

entries.title: Jamie McGonnigal
entries.summary: Jamie McGonnigal is an American voice actor who voices Tersly in Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Unnamed Suit 038
entries.summary: Unnamed Suit 038 is a Suit within the Organization. He operates from Vienna, Austria, under Klaus.

entries.title: Klaus' spiders

entries.title: Dark Pharaoh
entries.summary: Dark Pharaoh is a mysterious four-eyed Titan. He levitates across the battlefield, striking fear into the hearts of his enemies. This Titan has no arms, but that doesn't mean it doesn't pack a powerful punch, so to speak.

entries.title: Lioness
entries.summary: A lioness that lives on the uninhabited Indonesian island, near the Phoenix Volcano, approached Tersly while he was navigating the Huntik team through the underground labyrinth of the Lodestone. She was interested in his radio equipment before noticing him, advancing on him with the intention of eating him. When Lok Lambert managed to destroy the Lodestone and disable the anti-magic field, Tersly

entries.title: Caliban Ocean Warrior
entries.summary: Caliban Ocean Warrior is a Krono-Titan used by the mermen of Atlantis and is the Atlantian counterpart of Caliban. A golden masked warrior, Caliban Ocean Warrior is the fiercest known warrior of Atlantis. Instead of a mane of hair, this aquatic warrior sports seaweed which grows from his head.

entries.title: Alpha
entries.summary: Alpha is the codename of an elite Suit working for the Organization. He always works with his partner, Beta, and together they served as the personal bodyguards of the Professor.

entries.title: Beta
entries.summary: Beta is the codename of an elite Suit working for the Organization. He always works with his partner, Alpha, and together they served as the personal bodyguards of the Professor.

entries.title: Unnamed Suit 053
entries.summary: Unnamed Suit 053 is a Suit working for the Organization, previously commanded by Wilder.

entries.summary: Unnamed Suit 054 is a Suit working for the Organization, previously commanded by Wilder.

entries.title: Unnamed Suit 057
entries.summary: Unnamed Suit 057 is a Suit working for the Organization, previously commanded by Wilder.

entries.title: Unnamed Suit 058
entries.summary: Unnamed Suit 058 is a Suit working for the Organization, previously commanded by Wilder. He has a distinctive grey moustache and ponytail.

entries.title: Speedboat
entries.summary: Speedboats are a type of engine-powered watercraft used by the Huntik Foundation and the Organization for water-based missions. The Foundation's speedboats are brown with white stripes while the Organization's speedboats are grey with blue stripes.

entries.title: Venice Preparatory Academy
entries.summary: Venice Preparatory Academy is a prestigious private school established in an ancient abbey in Venice, Italy. It is the school that Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill both attended along with their rival, Ford.

entries.title: The Organization/List of vehicles
entries.summary: The Organization uses a number of different vehicles for its missions, with many of them stored in their bases all around the globe.

entries.title: Poisonfang
entries.summary: Poisonfang is a spell that produces a damaging green sludge from the casting Seeker's hands directed at the target. This spell often is used by members of the Organization and is similar to the acid that Kreutalk spits and to the Poisonheat spell.

entries.title: Organization Sedan
entries.summary: The Organization Sedans are the most common vehicle of choice for the Organization, being used for transportation, surveillance and espionage. These black cars are commonly driven by Suits to escort their superiors to and from missions, or to spy on enemy Seekers from afar.

entries.title: Huntik Foundation Jet
entries.summary: Jets are used by the Huntik Foundation to transport their Seekers on their missions around the world. Despite the jets' lack of heavy weaponry, each one is equipped with a Power Amplifier that can amplify the magnitude and strength of Seekers' powers. Additionally, there is an auto-pilot feature as well as vertical take-off and landing modes.

entries.title: Huntik Foundation's cabin cruiser
entries.summary: A cabin cruiser is a large motor yacht used by Huntik Foundation operatives for long journeys in open water. These boats are much bigger than the Speedboat models and feature a built-in GPS that links directly to a Seeker's Holotome.

entries.title: Deck boat
entries.summary: Deck boats are motorboats designed for short-range travel across open water. The Huntik Foundation have a number of deck boats with a blue-painted hull and a red bimini canopy.

entries.title: Dragon's Breath
entries.summary: The Dragon's Breath is an ancient blue aura that is projected from the Dragon's Cliffs and points the way to Avalon. It is not a physical bridge and anyone who attempts to step on it will pass straight through it. The mist trail is activated by powering up the two lamps on either side of the cliffs.

entries.title: Dragon's Cliffs
entries.summary: The Dragon's Cliffs is an ancient Casterwill family site on the coast of England. There is a large dragon sculpture carved into the cliff face, with two lamps which, when charged up, activates the Dragon's Breath, a blue mist trail that points the way to Avalon.

entries.title: Huntik Foundation Superyacht
entries.summary: The Huntik Foundation superyacht is a huge, futuristic-looking, streamlined vessel designed for long-range ocean travel. The Huntik Foundation use it to travel across the world in open water.

entries.title: Lok's dormitory
entries.summary: Lok Lambert's dormitory was where Lok resided while attending Venice Preparation Academy, which was located only a few blocks away. Due to Lok's lifestyle, the dorm was constantly messy with remnants of puzzles that Lok had completed lying on his desk. A high shelf ran around the entire room, upon which Lok has kept his unopened text books and various artifacts, some collected by his missing fathe

entries.title: Dante Vale's house
entries.summary: Dante's house is where Dante Vale lives in Venice, Italy. Dante's house has several floors with large, extravagant rooms as well as a rooftop deck. As his house seves as a base of operations for the Huntik Foundation, the house is fortified with Foundation technology and magic.

entries.title: Shuri Castle
entries.summary: Shuri Castle is a historical castle in Naha, Japan. Hidden beneath it are many secret tunnels, where Mr. Wilder set up an Organization base.

entries.title: Abandoned church in Paris
entries.summary: The abandoned church in Paris was built with a secret passage underneath the bell tower leading to the Paris Catacombs. The church could be seen from atop the Cathedral of Notre Dame.

entries.title: Yonaguni
entries.summary: Yonaguni is an island in Japan, once home to an highly advanced underwater civilisation. It is guarded by the giant Titan, Kyojin, whose own body makes up a part of the city that he guards. [The Guardian of Yonaguni]

entries.title: Joan of Arc's Ring
entries.summary: Joan of Arc's Ring was a Huntik Foundation mission that Dante Vale received on his Holotome. This mission was assigned as the final goal of the more-encompassing Mystery of the Paris Catacombs mission.

entries.title: YouTube
entries.summary: YouTube is an American video-sharing website headquartered in San Bruno, California and founded in 2005. On 27th October 2023, Rainbow S.p.A. launched the official YouTube channel for the Huntik series under the name Huntik Secrets & Seekers and the handle @HuntikOfficial. The channel began uploading full episodes of the series in HD quality, beginning with the first episode, "A Seeker Is Born".

entries.title: Elder Rue Guardian
entries.summary: The Elder Rue Guardian is the Casterwill family elder over curses and secrets. As the head of his house, he leads the other four Rue Guardians.

entries.title: List of Huntik Foundation Missions
entries.summary: Huntik Foundation missions are assigned to Huntik Foundation teams by the Huntik Foundation Council. These missions involve uncovering more information regarding magic and Titans as well as preventing the Organization from achieving their nefarious goals. Many notable missions were assigned by Guggenheim or Metz to the team of Dante Vale, Sophie Casterwill, Lok Lambert, Zhalia Moon, and newcomer D

entries.title: DVDs
entries.summary: DVDs (Digital Versatile/Video Discs) are home media releases that preceded online streaming. The first season of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers was released on DVD in several different countries including the US and Italy. Season 2 was not released on physical DVD but both seasons were eventually available to watch on numerous streaming platforms including Netflix, HappyKids.TV, Kidoodle and, most rece

entries.title: Jodis Lore
entries.summary: Jodis Lore was a Seeker who controlled an Amulet of Metagolem. He hid the Amulet in Prague, Czech Republic, in the Golem's Attic behind an enchanted door.

entries.title: Jodis Lore's Key
entries.summary: Jodis Lore's key is used to unlock the enchanted door to the Golem's Attic on the Road of Alchemists in Prague, Czech Republic.

entries.title: Emmanuel Dekoninck
entries.summary: Emmanuel Dekoninck is a Belgian actor and director who voiced Lok Lambert in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

entries.title: Prunelle Rulens
entries.summary:
Prunelle Rulens is a Belgian actress who voiced Sophie Casterwill in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

She is also the voice of Courtney in the French dub of the animated series Total Drama Island.

entries.title: Pierre Lognay
entries.summary:
Pierre Lognay is a Belgian actor who voiced Dante Vale in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

In other French dubs, he is notably the voice of multiple characters throughout the animated series Naruto Shippûden and of the Castor Clones in the television series Orphan Black.

entries.title: Florine Orphelin
entries.summary:
Florine Orphelin is a Belgian actress who voiced Zhalia Moon in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

In other French dubs, she is notably the voice of Chihiro in the animated movie Spirited Away, of Astrid Hofferson in the animated movies Dragons and of Hannah Baker in the television series 13 Reasons Why.

entries.title: Karim Barras
entries.summary:
Karim Barras is a French-Swiss actor who voiced Den Fears in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

Prior to Den's appearance in Season 2, he voiced the Elder Guardian of Thor, Unnamed Suit 013 and Eathon Lambert in Season 1.

entries.title: Holotome
entries.summary: A Holotome is a specialized green-hued tome used by Seekers in the Huntik Foundation. It combines technology and the magic of the Spirit World, Huntik. It acts like a magic-based computer to store and recall information based on vocal commands. Like a computer, they also have the ability to connect to such utilities as e-mail and internet browsing. Many of the additional capabilities of the Holoto

entries.title: Joanne Lee
entries.summary: Joanne Lee is the executive producer of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. Lee is the wife of Huntik creator Iginio Straffi, and the pair have a daughter together.

entries.title: Reliquary
entries.summary: A Reliquary is a magical chest used to contain cursed artifacts and dangerous Amulets.

entries.title: Mud Trap
entries.summary: The Mud Trap is a magical trap set up by Jodis Lore beneath his tomb in Prague Central Cemetery. It was designed to protect his study, which contained the key for his attic where his Titan, Metagolem, was hidden. The trap consists of a pool of viscous, mud-like substances capable of forming arms that restrain anyone who falls into it, while also preventing the use of magic. It was activated if som

entries.title: Liberty Equality Brotherhood
entries.summary: The Liberty Equality Brotherhood were a group of soldiers who hid in the Paris Catacombs during the French Revolution. An archaeologist served as a guide to show them around the catacombs. In their chest of tools, Lok Lambert found a scroll with an image from Eathon Lambert's journal on it. [Divide and Conquer]

entries.title: Venice Huntik Library
entries.summary: The Venice Huntik Library was built by the Huntik Foundation to house a portion of their books having to do with Seekers, Titans, and magic.

entries.title: Marco Polo Airport
entries.summary: Macro Polo Airport is an airport located in Venice, Italy.

entries.title: Bigfoot
entries.summary: Bigfoot is a mysterious wild Titan that resides in a snowy mountain range. Its appearance is that of a large muscular ape-like creature covered in white fur with large hands and feet while its face is decorated with Meso-American tribal markings.

entries.title: Bull
entries.summary: Bull is a dark-blue taurine Titan dressed in chitinous, beetle-like armor. Glowing with blue energy, its armor and three silver horns give it a cybernetic, futuristic appearance. As its name bluntly suggests, Bull Titans are wild elemental forces of primal instinct - chaotic, unruly, and untiring.

entries.title: Ghostly Bear
entries.summary: The Ghostly Bear is a mysterious spectral Titan that resides in an abandoned mine. It appears as a phantasmic glowing green bear dressed in wooden geometric armor and decorated with tribal carvings.

entries.title: The Organization's combat choppers
entries.summary: Combat Choppers are large blue military helicopters used by the Organization as their primary aerial vehicle. The choppers are piloted by the Organization Pilots and are heavily armed with missiles which can take down enemy planes.

entries.title: Unnamed Titan 007
entries.summary: An unnamed Titan is a tall avian humanoid with the head of an ibis. It wears an orange and gold Egyptian ceremonial garb and has long thin limbs and talons, from which it casts a mystical purple aura. Its Amulet is in the possession of Lok Lambert.

entries.title: Unnamed Titan 008
entries.summary: An unnamed Titan has a bestial hyena-like appearance with brown fur and glowing orange eyes. A large pack of these Titans lie waiting at the bottom of a shaft.

entries.title: Unnamed Titan 009
entries.summary: An unnamed Titan has a dark shadowy wolf-like appearance with purple fur, pointed ears and piercing yellow eyes. A huge pack of these Titans reside in an unidentified mountainous region.

entries.title: Unnamed Titan 010
entries.summary: Unnamed Titan 010 has the appearance of a towering golem entirely built from large stone monoliths, covered in Egyptian hieroglyphics. It the first to enter hostile terrain and smash through a path of its Seeker like a living battering ram. Its Amulet is in the possession of Grier.

entries.title: Unnamed Titan 011
entries.summary: Unnamed Titan 011 has the appearance an Egyptian-themed reptile man wearing a brown tunic and a striped nemes-like headdress. In its hand it wields a golden staff with a green gem. This Titan specializes in labor enforcement and keeping smaller Titans in line.

entries.title: Unnamed Titan 012
entries.summary: Unnamed Titan 012 is a teal scarab-like Titan with an armored shell and six long legs. It is used for transport and tunneling. Its Amulet is in the possession of DeFoe.

entries.title: Unnamed Titan 013
entries.summary: Unnamed Titan 013 is a muscular purple-skinned Yama-Titan that resembles an ape-like demon. It dons a purple outfit inspired by Chinese-Japanese culture and wields a sharp double-edged scimitar. Its Amulet was in the possession of DeFoe.

entries.title: Guinevere
entries.summary: Guinevere was the wife of King Arthur, whom Sir Lancelot fell in love with, ultimately making him unworthy on his quest for the Holy Grail and causing him to fail.

entries.title: Knights of the Round Table
entries.summary: The Knights of the Round Table were an order of knights formed by King Arthur to protect his kingdom and, later, undertook the quest for the Holy Grail. One of its members, Sir Lancelot, was head of one of the main branch families of the Casterwill family, and later fell from grace after falling in love with Guinevere, Arthur's wife.

entries.title: Sir Bors
entries.summary: Sir Bors was one of the Knights of the Round Table. He later undertook the quest for the Holy Grail in which he succeeded alongside Sir Galahad and Sir Percival. He was renowned for being a hard worker and, on his quest, he achieved what the powerful Sir Lancelot could not.

entries.title: Sir Galahad
entries.summary: Sir Galahad was one of the Knights of the Round Table. He later undertook the quest for the Holy Grail and succeeded alongside Sir Bors and Sir Percival.

entries.title: Sir Percival
entries.summary: Sir Percival was one of the Knights of the Round Table. He later undertook the quest for the Holy Grail and succeeded alongside Sir Bors and Sir Galahad.

entries.title: Holy Grail
entries.summary: The Holy Grail was a sacred and legendary cup that was sought after by King Arthur who sent the Knights of the Round Table on a quest find it. Three knights succeeded in the quest, Sir Bors, Sir Galahad and Sir Percival while Sir Lancelot was unsuccessful due his falling in love with Guinevere, the wife of King Arthur. [Memory Lane]

entries.title: Unnamed Titan 014
entries.summary: Unnamed Titan 014 is a Yama-Titan that wears red samurai armor and a stylized kabuto helmet with two horns. Its face is painted like a kabuki performer, like that of Kabuki, while it wields lightning in place of its lower arms.

entries.summary: Miniatures - also known as 3D Miniatures - is a line of collectible Titan minifigures and Amulets based on Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The line was originally distributed by Tridimensional in Italy in individual blind bags and sold at Italian newsagents. entries.summary: Rassimov's files are files contained in a dossier with information on Rassimov and his weaknesses. entries.title: Action Figures
entries.summary: The Huntik Action Figures are a range of fully articulated figures based on Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. They were manufactured by Big Bocca and released by Upper Deck in December 2009, being sold in the UK, US and across Europe. The range consisted of three lines, the Seeker Figures, the Titan Figures and the Titan Deluxe Figures.

entries.title: Lights & Sounds Action Figures
entries.summary: The Lights & Sounds Action Figures are a line of fully articulated figures produced by Giochi Preziosi in 2011, based on Season 2 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The line was made up of three electronic Powerbonded Titan figures which all featured unique lights and sound effects activated by inserting an Amulet into its back.

She is notably the voice of Stella in the French dub of Iginio Straffi's other animated series, Winx Club.

entries.summary: The Prague Huntik Hotel is a safehouse owned by the Huntik Foundation located in the centre of Prague, Czech Republic.

entries.title: Quatrains of Nostradamus
entries.summary: The Quatrains of Nostradamus are a set of fifty prophecies made by ancient Casterwill seer Nostradamus. They would help the Huntik Foundation to uncover the hidden powers and Titans of the Casterwill family, and help protect humanity against the Blood Spiral and the Nullifiers.

entries.title: Chu-Goku Mount
entries.summary:
The Chu-Goku Mount is a mountain range in Japan.

It was the resting place of Divine Mirror Kagami, before being uncovered by Eathon the dog and Hoffman on behalf of The Organization. [Knight of the Willblade]

entries.title: Pyramid of the Moon
entries.summary: The Pyramid of the Moon is the second-largest temple in the Aztec capital of Teotihuacan, Mexico, situated near the Pyramid of the Sun.

entries.title: Geoffrey Crayon
entries.summary: Geoffrey Crayon is an elderly resident of the town of Sleepy Hollow who discovered his Seeker powers by chance after finding the Amulet of Headless Hessian near his town.

entries.title: Knifepoint
entries.summary: Shadowknife is a spell used to throw magical knives at an enemy at extreme speed. The knives thrown emit a blue glow, this spell can be cast while holding a knife or simply summoning it from the users hand. It is similar to the spell Shadowknife.

entries.title: The Organization's motorbikes
entries.summary: The Organization's motorbikes are dark blue motorbikes used by the Organization.

entries.title: Huntik Foundation's motorbikes
entries.summary: Motorbikes are used by the Huntik Foundation. They come in different colors and feature the Foundation's logo on the front.

entries.title: Huntik Foundation's cargo jet
entries.summary: Cargo jets are used by the Huntik Foundation to transport heavy material or vehicles across the world. There are no proper seats for passengers, and no armament.

entries.title: Dante Vale's motorbike
entries.summary: Dante Vale's motorbike is a burgundy motorbike used by Dante Vale. It is unclear whether Dante owns the bike or rented it.

entries.title: Taihang Mountains
entries.summary: The Taihang Mountains is a large mountain range located in China. There is a temple, which is home to Master Storm and his granddaughter, Lin Storm.

entries.title: Ignatius
entries.summary: Ignatius is a Titan based on the element of fire. It is similar to a moving body of lava which is always ablaze. It can get incredibly hot, and produce great amounts of light. Both Dante Vale and Kiel possess an Ignatius Amulet.

entries.title: Fireblade
entries.summary: Fireblade is a ninja-like Yama-Titan who uses its stealth and fiery abilities in battle.

entries.title: Archwarder
entries.summary: Archwarder resembles a plant with a giant, wilted, bloomed flower and three strong roots as legs. It is the ultimate defense against the Legendary Titans, as this plant-based Titan is able to counter even the Legendary Titans' unique abilities and to level the playing field for Archwarder's Seeker.

stats.special_ability: Makes high-powered Titans difficult to control

entries.title: The Legacy of Thor
entries.summary: The Huntik Foundation team is sent on a mission to gain control of Mjolnir, a mystical weapon once used by Thor, an ancient Seeker. However, the Organization is believed to have spies among the Guardians of Thor. They must seek additional help from Tersly, a Foundation researcher, and Montehue, the number two Foundation Seeker under Dante Vale himself.

entries.title: The Hammer of Thor
entries.summary: The Hammer of Thor mission was assigned in "The Legacy of Thor." The first part of the mission, reaching the Temple of Thor, was achieved by the end of "The Legacy of Thor." By the end of "Two Powers Become One," the full mission was successfully completed, Lok Lambert received credit with the Huntik Foundation due to his quick thinking in getting the hammer.

entries.title: Thor
entries.summary: Thor was an ancient Seeker of Iceland. According to Norse legend, Thor defended Asgard, the realm of the gods, against the Frost Giant, Ymir. His weapon of choice was the magical hammer, Mjolnir, which was said to have been forged from pure lightning. [The Legacy of Thor]

entries.title: Mjolnir
entries.summary: Mjolnir, the hammer of Thor, is an incredibly heavy hammer, making it very difficult to wield. Despite its weight, when it is spun it charges with incredible electrical energy and then thrown, it releases devastating power that can send powerful Titans, such as Ymir, back to their Amulets.

entries.title: Guardians of Thor
entries.summary: The Guardians of Thor are Seekers of an ancient cult that has been in existence for thousands of years preserving the ways of the Norse gods. They reside in the Temple of Thor in Iceland, where they guarded Mjolnir, Thor's magical hammer.

entries.title: Spidertouch
entries.summary: Spidertouch is a spell that allows the casting Seeker to cling to any surface, regardless of the material that it is made of. When it is cast, a sticky, web-like substance extends out of the fingertips of the caster and connects with whatever the Seeker is trying to cling to. Spidertouch can also allow the Seeker to shoot out a web to either entangle an opponent or create a web to keep the Seeker

entries.title: Bristlebind
entries.summary: Bristlebind is a spell that causes a number of thorny vines to grow out of the ground and then wrap around an opposing target. These vines not only cause damage due to the thorns but also restrict movement. It is manifested initially as a beam of red energy on the Seeker's hand, which then produces the vines. The vines can either be projected directly from the beam or from a surface with which the

entries.title: Ymir
entries.summary: Ymir the Frost Giant is a colossal Litho-Titan similar Metagolem. Ymir is used by the Guardians of Thor to protect the Temple of Thor and Thor's mystic hammer, Mjolnir. The Guardians use the Incantation of Asgard in order to invoke him from his Amulet and to control him.

entries.title: Ice Creature
entries.summary: Ice Creatures are goblins of ice who serve Ymir, the king of the frost giants. Along with the Frost Minion Titans, Ymir is capable of summoning an army of these Titans to do battle. They are so cold that, when defeated, they explode in a shower of ice crystals.

entries.title: Venadek
entries.summary: Venadek is an odd little Titan. Researchers at the Huntik Foundation are still unsure as to whether these Titans are to be considered rats, goblins, lizards, scorpions, or some chimera of them all. Despite their size, Venadek Titans are fierce in battle as well as loyal to their Seekers.

entries.title: Montehue
entries.summary: Montehue is the Huntik Foundation's second highest ranked Seeker. He is also a close friend of Dante Vale's having formed their friendship through a rivalry. Montehue's assistant, Tersly, tends to accompany Montehue on missions.

entries.title: Neptunia
entries.summary: Neptunia is an aquatic Krono-Titan with purple skin and elf-like ears.

entries.title: Hoplite
entries.summary: Hoplite is a centaur-like Titan possessing the body and legs of a lion. These armored warriors, though relatively weak on their own, gain power when working together as an army. They are closely related to the lion-like gladiator Titan, Bellona.

entries.title: Enfluxion
entries.summary: Enfluxion is a Titan whose body is made up entirely of water. Unlike Undine, Enfluxion has a much more unearthly visage and possesses tendrils of water for arms. Her Amulet is in the possession of Sophie Casterwill after being given to her as a gift from Teien Casterwill.

entries.title: Temple of Thor
entries.summary: The Temple of Thor is a building dedicated to the ancient Seeker, Thor. Thor's hammer, Mjolnir, was kept here and guarded by the Guardians of Thor prior prior to being retrieved by Dante Vale, Tersly, Lok Lambert, Montehue, Zhalia Moon, and Sophie Casterwill. The only way to get to the temple, aside from flying, is to utilize the Rainbow Bridge. The temple is laced with magic and kept the wild Tit

entries.title: Thundercut
entries.summary:
Thundercut is an offensive spell. It creates a purple aura of electric energy, which can be used on close contact or fired from the distance. Upon contact, the target suffers significant pain from the electric discharge, and may be paralyzed.

It is an ancient power and the sole favored spell of the Guardians of Thor.

entries.title: Gleipnir
entries.summary: Gleipnir is a magical rope which cannot be broken through any means.

entries.title: Black Scarabese
entries.summary: Black Scarabese is a Hecto-Titan closely related to the Gold Scarabese. These small beetle Titans might seem harmless at first, but they are used in the field to gather intelligence. Together with Gold Scarabese, they can form the powerful Anubian.

entries.title: Rainbow Bridge
entries.summary: The Rainbow Bridge is a magical bridge that allowed Dante Vale, Sophie Casterwill, Lok Lambert, Zhalia Moon, Tersly, and Montehue to cross a canyon to get to the Temple of Thor. In Norse mythology it was used to gain access to Asgard, the realm of the gods. Dante, Lok, and Zhalia used their Titans Ignatius, Kipperin, and Strix to create rain and sunlight in order to make the rainbow bridge. [The L

aliases: TCG:Defeat Ymir - Frost King Expert Mission

entries.title: Yuri Lowenthal
entries.summary:
Yuri Lowenthal is a voice actor who has voiced several anime and video game characters including Lok Lambert in Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers.

Yuri Lowenthal was born in Ohio as the son of a Foreign Service officer, resulting in his being raised in the United States, Africa, and Europe. He was graduated from the College of William and Mary with a degree in East Asian studies and held a jo

entries.title: Rebecca Soler
entries.summary: Rebecca Soler (second name pronounced "so-lair" ), sometimes credited under the name of Jessica Paquet, is an American voice actress, who works on the properties of 4Kids Entertainment. In Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, she does the voice for Sophie Casterwill. She is also known for her roles as Tecna and Setlla in fellow Rainbow-production Winx Club, as well as many other roles in anime and animation

entries.title: TCG:SAS-145
aliases: TCG:Defeat Ymir - Frost King Training Mission

entries.title: Fenris
entries.summary: Fenris is a powerful wolf-like Titan, the only known specimen of which once roamed through the caves under the Temple of Thor. This wild and animalistic Titan was later used by Montehue, becoming among his choice Titans in the fight against evil Seeker groups. Many Seekers think Fenris and Wolf Knight were behind the legends of werewolves.

entries.title: Tolivane
entries.summary: Tolivane are small, fairy-like Titans somewhat resembling moles. Although their base stats are relatively low, their "Defense" ability allows them to survive attacks which would normally send them back to their Amulets.

entries.title: Lunar
entries.summary: Lunar is a small, sprite-like Titan that wields the power of the moon. Lunar, though small, is capable of releasing her power outward in the form of a much larger elemental which can be controlled much like a magical suit of armor. Lunar's Amulet is in the possession of Sandra Lambert, along with Solar, who wields the power of the sun.

entries.title: Rings
entries.summary: Rings are powerful artifacts which have the same abilities as Amulets. Like Amulets, they contain Titans and allow them to pass between Earth and the Spirit World of Huntik. Much more powerful Titans are contained within rings than in normal Amulets, and all known rings shown contain a Legendary Titan.

entries.title: King Basilisk
entries.summary: King Basilisk is a Titan of legends as the greatest among basilisks. A normal basilisk's breath is toxic, and its gaze has the ability to turn others into stone. The same is true of King Basilisk. Its Stonegaze ability can turn others into stone, although the King Basilisk also possesses the ability to undo these effects at will.

entries.title: Terrapede
entries.summary: Terrapede is a Titan related to Mindrone, Enforcer, and Gigadrone, and his primary power rests in his single enormous eye. Able to traverse challenging terrain with his powerful spike legs and blast enemies with energy from his eye, Terrapede is not to be trifled with. This Titan is awarded to up-and-coming Organization operatives after they have shown promise in battle against the Huntik Foundati

entries.title: Coralgolem
entries.summary: Coralgolem is the favored defender of Casterwill coastal and sub-oceanic strongholds; the family of Seekers will do anything to add another rare Coralgolem to their collection. The Mermen Seekers also summoned Coralgolems to counter Dante Vale's use of Metagolem in the Test of Prowess to enter Atlantis.

entries.title: Shakrit
entries.summary: Shakrit is an enormous, serpentine Swara-Titan. Due to its size and dexterity, Shakrit is used both for combat and transportation. Gliding through the air as an eel glides through water, Shakrit quickly leaves the Blood Spiral's destruction in its wake at Wind's command.

entries.title: Dendras
entries.summary: Dendras is a masked puppeteer Titan who controls twin marionettes, one which controls the power of fire and one which controls the power of ice. This Titan was passed on from Simon Judeau to Eathon Lambert before their respective disappearances and was later recovered by his son, Lok Lambert.

stats.special_ability:
Marionettes that shoot fire and ice, with Baselaird its strings 
control enemy Titans

entries.title: Pan
entries.summary: Pan is a Gaia-Titan resembling a faun or satyr. He has the hindquarters, ears and horns of a goat and the torso, arms, and head of a man.

entries.title: Icarus
entries.summary: Icarus are humanoid Krono-Titans who possess bird-like wings instead of arms. Icarus Titans are commonly used by Casterwill family members alongside Feyone, and one appears in the arsenal of Sophie Casterwill.

entries.title: Lindorm
entries.summary: Lindorm is a powerful draconic Gaia-Titan used heavily by Lok Lambert. Controlling this Titan requires his Seeker to be in complete control of both thoughts and emotions. One mis-directed thought and Lindorm will charge like a raging bull to make quick work of the one targeted by this thought. Because of this, Lindorm can be thought of as a loose cannon. Though Lindorm may be aggressive and violen

entries.title: Gold Scarabese
entries.summary: Gold Scarabese is a Hecto-Titan closely related to the Black Scarabese. These small beetle Titans may seem harmless at first, but they are primarily used for relaying information from the field. Together with the Black Scarabese Titans, they can form the powerful Anubian.

entries.title: Two Powers Become One
entries.summary: Dante Vale and Montehue must put aside their differences and their rivalry when they get separated from their teammates if they are to successfully wield Thor's hammer, Mjolnir and keep it from getting into the Organization's clutches.

entries.title: Absent Heroes
entries.summary: An old friend of Dante Vale is struck with an incurable illness, but Dante is determined to get him well. His travels lead the gang to Vienna, Austria, the home of an ancient Titan, King Basilisk, which the Organization wishes to claim as their own, and the home of additional clues from Lok's father's journal.

entries.title: Darkfog
entries.summary: Darkfog is a spell used to confuse the enemy by emitting a stream of dark fog. This can be done to obscure an opponent's vision for an unseen attack or an emergency escape.

entries.title: Ashtoreth
entries.summary: Ashtoreth the Colossus is one of the three massive Colossi set up by the Queen of Sheba to guard King Solomon's mines against invaders.

entries.title: Fire Kappa
entries.summary: Fire Kappa is a turtle-like Yama-Titan who dons a magical fire that blazes from the top of his head. Though the water kappa of Japanese myths can be either helpful or cruel, most Fire Kappa are friendly.

entries.title: Scolopen
entries.summary: Scolopen is a Swara-Titan that resembles a cross between a centipede and a barbarian warrior. Though Scolopen Titans are not very strong, they work hard and are easy to summon as a group.

entries.title: Furoji
entries.summary: Furoji is a red-skinned Yama-Titan that can control fire through the art of meditation.

entries.title: Forest Queen Diana
entries.summary: Forest Queen Diana is the favored Titan of Hippolyta, the ruler of the hidden Amazonian tribe who worship Diana as a goddess.

entries.title: Sentinel
entries.summary: Sentinel is a Meso-Titan that resembles one of the great stone statues on Easter Island. This floating head provides its Seeker with an excellent mode of defense with its Stoneshield ability. Alongside Albion, it is a signature Titan of LeBlanche, the guardian of Sophie Casterwill.

entries.title: Mermen
entries.summary: The Mermen are a group of Seekers that reside in the Casterwill compound of Atlantis. They are the Test of Prowess for those who wish to enter the compound, the former resting place of the Amulet of Will.

entries.title: Scarlet Byrne
entries.summary: Scarlet Byrne is a resourceful red-headed member of the Huntik Foundation who was renowned in the group for her beauty and her distinct Irish accent. Close to the Lambert family, she was Lok Lambert’s babysitter in Ireland and his childhood crush. Scarlet isn't as skilled as Dante Vale but she is nevertheless a brave and capable Seeker.

entries.title: Doublespell
entries.summary: Doublespell is a multiplication spell that allows Seekers to cast another spell twice. It typically results in the spell being projected with both hands instead of one, but it can also be channelled through one hand to make the spell twice as powerful.

entries.title: Megataur
entries.summary: Megataur is a half-bull, half-man Titan bound by gold chains. This Titan is considered a symbol of the Sutos nobility and as such will only bond with a Seeker of the Sutos Island royal family. Megataur was used by Zan-Sutos before its Amulet was given to his son, Grier.

entries.title: Goblin Brownie
entries.summary: Goblin Brownie is a flag-bearing, diminutive goblin-like Titan. At first glance, Goblin Brownie may seem to present little threat to a larger, more melee-oriented opponent, but this is exactly the image Goblin Brownie wants to convey. Goblin Brownie is capable of using the flags he carries for offense, defense, and even evading traps.

entries.title: Hoozoto
entries.summary: Hoozoto is like a crazed guard dog, except a guard dog doesn't jump on your back when it bites, nor does it have a tail-claw to punch anyone else who gets near it.

entries.title: Madea
entries.summary: Madea is a Krono-Titan illusionist of mythology. Her illusion abilities are able to conceal her true form as a Titan, allowing her to appear and speak as a normal human being. In her true form, her lower half resembles that of a turtle with four flippers and a hard shell.

entries.title: TCG:SAS-022
aliases: TCG:Sophie Casterwill - Heir of the Casterwills
entries.subtitle: Sophie Casterwill — Heir of the Casterwills

entries.title: Bonelasher
entries.summary: Bonelasher is the evolved cousin of Redcap, the favored Titan of low-level Organization Suits, but he is a bit stronger and harder to control. With the same aggression and passion for combat as his Titan relative, Bonelasher is best unleashed by his Seeker in the midst of a battle. With his army of razor-sharp claws and teeth, Bonelasher is best fought at distance.

entries.title: Enforcer
entries.summary: Enforcer is a flying, insectoid Swara-Titan possessing six arms. It has three red eyes for its face from which it can shoot laser beams. Enforcer is a weaker cousin of Mindrone and Terrapede, and is used by members of the Organization for ranged and aerial combat.

entries.title: Gybolg
entries.summary: Gybolg is a fierce Gaia-Titan from the stories of Celtic Ireland who belonged to the fierce dog warrior, Cú Chulainn. Gybolg's name means "barbed spear" and represents the strength of earth and the swiftness of water. He wields a mighty sword and can summon forest minions named Calbolg to fight by his side.

entries.title: Solar
entries.summary: Solar is a small, sprite-like Titan that wields the power of the sun. Solar, though small, is capable of releasing his power outward in the form of a much larger elemental which can be controlled much like a magical suit of armor. Solar's Amulet is in the possession of Sandra Lambert, along with Lunar, who wields the power of the moon.

entries.title: Tersly
entries.summary: Tersly is a Huntik Foundation Seeker and the loyal assistant of Montehue. Tersly's strengths lie in his work as a researcher and he possesses a wide-stretching knowledge of history and mythology.

entries.title: Metz
entries.summary: Metz is the chairman of the Huntik Foundation and was the mentor of Dante Vale throughout his childhood. For a long period of time, he was bedridden due to the Curse of the Legendary Titans but, after this was lifted, recovered and returned to his position as the head of the Huntik Foundation Council.

entries.title: Sandra Lambert
entries.summary: Sandra Lambert is a Seeker and retired member of the Huntik Foundation. The wife of Eathon Lambert and mother to Lok Lambert and Kathy Lambert, Sandra lives in County Kerry, Ireland.

entries.title: To Be Together
entries.summary: Lok and his friends must fight the guardians of King Solomon's mines so they can then enter the mines in order to find the Amulet of the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao. The Professor, though, is already one step ahead of the team, doing everything in his power to get to the Amulet first.

entries.title: Home Turf
entries.summary: The Huntik team goes on holiday to Lok Lambert's homeland of Ireland. There, Lok discovers that his mom, Sandra Lambert, has been a Seeker of the Huntik Foundation. They meet Scarlet Byrne, Lok's old babysitter and another Huntik Foundation member, who invites them to search for a Titan known as Gybolg. Meanwhile, Zhalia is told by Klaus to betray Dante Vale and the rest of the team.

entries.title: The Unseen Guide
entries.summary: Sophie Casterwill manages to get Eathon Lambert's journal repaired and the team head on to discover the mythical city of Atlantis. Meanwhile, Zhalia Moon rejoins the gang. However, Rassimov spies on them and won't make it easy for the heroes.

entries.title: Kathy Lambert
entries.summary: Kathy Lambert is the older sister of Lok Lambert and the daughter of both Sandra Lambert and Eathon Lambert. Unlike the rest of her family, she has no Seeker powers or knowledge of the Huntik Foundation.

entries.title: Klaus
entries.summary: Klaus was an evil professor who found Zhalia Moon in the slums of Amsterdam as a child and raised her to be a spy for the Organization. He is a scientist and alchemist known for his magical technology, enhanced spells, and experimental Titans.

entries.title: Ash
entries.summary: Ash is a mummified Hecto-Titan who is capable of turning into dust to evade attacks. Two large, tree-like branches protrude from her shoulder blades. She is one of Shauna's primary Titans.

entries.title: Casterwill family
entries.summary: The Casterwill family is the oldest Seeker family in history, having descended from Lord Casterwill, the original Seeker who brought the Titans to Earth using the Amulet of Will. The family opposed and fought a 500-year war against the Nullifiers to save the Earth from destruction. Because of their stand against evil, the Casterwill name is one of nobility and honour, and commands great respect in

entries.title: List of episodes
entries.summary: The following is a list of episodes for the animated television series, Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. The first season premiered on January 3, 2009, in both the UK and the US. The second season premiered in Italy on September 17, 2011, before airing in the UK on April 16, 2012, and in the US on April 21, 2013.

entries.title: Seeker Training
entries.summary: Seeker Training is required by the Huntik Foundation for new or beginner Seekers. Though the player has not yet completed this training, he or she was still assigned a mission by the Foundation to investigate Organization activity in Venice, Italy. [Adventure Game]

entries.title: Blood Spiral
entries.summary: The Blood Spiral are a cult of evil Seekers whose purpose is to serve the will of the Betrayer, the sworn ancestral enemy of the Casterwill family, and to erase all life by bringing the Nullifiers back to Earth. The group have a long history of tradition and ritual, using dark, ancient magic and Titans, and with every member bearing a tattoo of the sigil of the Spiral Mark, the original beacon tha

entries.title: Curse of the Legendary Titans
entries.summary: The Curse of the Legendary Titans is an incredibly powerful and deadly curse that was placed on the Rings of the Legendary Titans by Lord Casterwill and that causes those who disturb them without the Amulet of Will to be struck by an incurable ailment. This ailment targets the very will of its victims, and this cannot be combatted even through magic.

entries.title: Nordrake
entries.summary: Nordrake is a blue and white flying Litho-Titan that resembles an ice-dragon, held in reserve by the Professor for his final confrontations against the Huntik Foundation. Nordrake, along with the destructive Dominator, is one of the Professor's most powerful and favored Titans, besides Araknos.

entries.title: Red Searcher
entries.summary: Red Searcher lacks significant combat powers, but he is among the most adept trap finders in the Titan world. With his magically enhanced vision and sensory abilities, traps, secret doors, enchantments, and hidden treasure are revealed to the Seeker controlling him.

entries.title: Thornment
entries.summary: Thornment, one of several mummy-like Hecto-Titans, inspired the mythology of ancient Egypt. Within her wraps, Thornment is a mass of living, thorny vines, which she is able to expertly control as extensions of her own being. Whether whipping, slicing, tying, or tripping, Thornment is a powerful foe. One Thornment was the primary Titan of Rassimov.

entries.title: Cavalier
entries.summary: Cavalier is a powerful armored Titan who belonged to Sir Lancelot. A fighter, through and through, his armor is enchanted, his blades burn eternally, and his passion for battle is unmatched.

entries.title: Stopglue
entries.summary: Stopglue is a spell that creates a stream of a sticky, glue-like substance. As such, this spell can be used to render enemies or objects immobile without actually causing damage.

entries.title: Sekhmet
entries.summary: Sekhmet is a Hecto-Titan with the body of a purple-furred lioness. Her garb is similar to that of Egyptian royalty. She uses her two scimitars to protect her Seeker, whether a pharaoh or an Organization operative.

entries.title: Ammit Heart-Eater
entries.summary: Ammit Heart-Eater is a Hecto-Titan that resembles a blue-skinned crocodile, dressed in golden armor and a teal robe. Her sharp teeth make her a fearsome Titan and is thus often called upon by members of the Organization in battle.

entries.title: The Treasures of the Argonauts
entries.summary: The Huntik team travel to Greece, on a quest to find the legendary Argo of Jason and the Argonauts. It's not long however before they end up in a final confrontation with DeFoe, who is set on revenge.

entries.title: The Beautiful Trap
entries.summary: While resting and relaxing in Greece, the Seekers await further instructions from Guggenheim. They Don't have to wait to long before Guggenheim sends them off on their next mission. They must use the map they recovered from the wreck and go out to sea. To do this they are given one of the most up to date Foundation boats in order to complete their mission. The heroes follow the journey of the Argo

entries.title: Stormshield
entries.summary: Stormshield is a defensive spell. It creates a purple shield around the caster to repulse and redirect offensive spells. It is favored by members of the Blood Spiral.

entries.title: Ropetrick
entries.summary: Ropetrick is a spell used to manipulate pieces of rope and is manifested through a yellow aura. This spell is highly versatile and can be used for tying knots, binding enemies, or saving falling allies.

entries.title: Antedeluvian
entries.summary: Antedeluvian is a vampiric Draco-Titan twisted by his master, Vlad Tepes, also known as Dracula. The Titan and Seeker pair planted the seeds of the Transylvanian Dracula myths. From his massive, bat-like wings to his pale blue skin, enormous strength, and energy-draining bite, Antedeluvian is perhaps the one creature more terrifying than the mythological vampire which he inspired.

entries.title: Ariel
entries.summary: Ariel is a protective, loyal Gaia-Titan with a mastery over the wind and storms. Able to create vortexes of energy from his hands and tornadoes that travel hundreds of kilometers, Ariel is one of the primary Titans of Dante Vale, having been given to him by his mentor, Metz.

entries.title: Baselaird
entries.summary: Baselaird is a Krono-Titan inherited by Lok Lambert from his father, Eathon Lambert, and appears as a warrior of the sun. Though his base stats are relatively low, Baselaird quickly became one of Lok's primary Titans. With Baselaird's large shield and powerful curved sword, this golden-armored Titan is not one to be trifled with.

entries.title: Brahe
entries.summary: Brahe is a large, golem-like Titan whose massive body is covered in ancient runes. Rumor within the Organization states that the mad scientist, Klaus, experimentally created Brahe from a Metagolem Titan. Brahe is also related to the Coralgolem, Undergolem, and Chaingolem Titans.

entries.title: Bulreguard
entries.summary: Bulreguard is a dog-like Gaia-Titan that resembles a brown-furred bulldog wearing a spiked collar and Celtic-inspired clothing with red, black, and yellow designs. As man's best friend in the world of Titans, Bulreguard Titans are often used outside of battle as companions for Seekers. Their keen senses and friendly demeanor make them valuable when adventuring.

entries.title: Chemosh
entries.summary: Chemosh the Colossus is one of the three massive Colossi set up by the Queen of Sheba to guard King Solomon's mines against invaders.

entries.title: Dervish
entries.summary: Dervish is a quadrupedal Swara-Titan with an insectoid abdomen and a bestial head with four horns. Its body is covered in dangerous, barbed spines from head to toe, and even blocking his strikes can be fatal.

entries.title: Dominator
entries.summary: Dominator is one of the Professor's most powerful and choice Titans alongside Nordrake and Araknos. It is a fierce Titan with large, spiked fists and an ability that can revert a Titan to its unbonded archetype.

stats.special_ability: Spikes which cause Titans to revert to their core archetypes

entries.title: Impet
entries.summary: Impet, a twisted, darker brother of Cherit, is a small, nimble Titan with dark blue skin. Adept at hiding and sneaking up on his target, he possesses the ability to enhance his allies or curse his enemies. Impet Amulets are in the possession of multiple Organization agents.

entries.title: Jirwolf
entries.summary: Jirwolf is a spectral wolf Titan with enhanced senses over time and space. Unlike the wild Fenris and Wolf Knight Titans, Jirwolf is capable of taking an astral form. He is one of Eathon Lambert's most powerful Titans.

entries.title: Milcom
entries.summary: Milcom the Colossus is one of the three massive Colossi set up by the Queen of Sheba to guard King Solomon's mines against invaders.

entries.title: Nighlurker
entries.summary: Nighlurker is a creepy monster of a Titan that once served as a guardian of Egyptian tombs. It likes to ambush unsuspecting Seekers and drag them off into the darkness.

entries.title: Tome
entries.summary:
A Tome combines technology and the magical secrets of the Huntik world. Essentially, it is a computer that displays information using a holographic 3-D display that works on voice commands. It also is capable of producing a physical card.

Tomes can store information on all known Titans, as well unknown Titans and their abilities, the information of which can be displayed in the form of a card. Ad

entries.title: Cypherdex
entries.summary:
The Cypherdex is the original Tome that that all others are based upon.

A key piece of equipment for Casterwill Seekers, it is controlled by voice commands and is capable of displaying 3-D holographic images of Titans, their abilities, powers, and is able to map local areas. It is also capable of communication with other Tomes, scanning objects and storing information. The Cypherdex is bright ele

entries.title: Teknonomicon
entries.summary: The Teknonomicon is a black tome used by the Organization. The Teknonomicon was invented by Klaus through reverse engineering the Huntik Foundation's Holotome. [OAL-022] Like the standard Holotome, this device provides stat and ability information on Titans as well as data on locations and spells. It can also be relayed visual surveillance from the eye of Mindrone. [Absent Heroes] The device appea

entries.title: Loreslave
entries.summary: The Loreslave is a Tome used by the Blood Spiral Brotherhood. This tome is blood red in color and has large, purple fangs which curl around the body. It is known that the Loreslave has the standard Tome abilities of providing information on Titans and locations.

entries.title: Trapfeaster
entries.summary: Trapfeaster deals with pesky traps and inconveniences in his own special way by eating them, unlike many trap-detecting Titans who simply alert their Seekers to the danger. He's as happy swallowing an arrow meant for his Seeker as he is sucking the magic out of a cursed doorknob.

entries.title: Shauna
entries.summary: Shauna is a member of the Blood Spiral and part of the Blooded Circle that answers directly to Rassimov. Alongside her silent partner, Wind, she is one of the powerful and deadly Seekers in the Blood Spiral. She particularly has an axe to grind against the Casterwill family, desiring to destroy Sophie Casterwill.

entries.title: Cyphercall
entries.summary: Cyphercall is a summoning spell which allows the caster to summon a Cypherdex. This spell is identical to Cyphersummon and similar to the spell Bladecall.

entries.title: Sorrowbond
entries.summary: Sorrowbond is a spell used to sever the bond between Titans or artifacts and their Seekers. When cast, a rainbow colored “barrier” appears around the Amulet or other item which floats towards the caster.

entries.title: Wind
entries.summary: Wind is the silent and powerful partner of Shauna and one of the deadliest members of the Blood Spiral. Despite the fact that he is mute, he is still capable of using magic, allowing him to act as a silent assassin. The deadly duo travel on Wind's sole colossal flying Titan, Shakrit.

entries.title: Undergolem
entries.summary: Undergolem is a golem-like Litho-Titan that is even larger and stronger than the already agility-challenged Metagolem, but also slower. His face and head is protected by a yellow helmet, while an arm-band covers each of his wrists.

entries.title: Fan Dancer
entries.summary: Fan Dancer is a mysterious Titan who hides her face behind a white mask and wears hair sticks to hold her blue hair. She wears red samurai armor into battle and is armed with razor-sharp war fans.

entries.title: Ponderous
entries.summary: Ponderous is a brontosaurus-like Litho-Titan so big and slow that it takes a long time to summon him. Nobody has ever seen him start a fight, but this Titan often ends them.

entries.title: Iron Monkey
entries.summary: Iron Monkey is an red-skinned Yama-Titan that resembles the Redcap Titans. Bearing red samurai armor and packing a powerful punch, this monkey-like Titan makes up what Redcap lacks in both offense and defense. If his sucker-covered tongue were not enough to strike fear into his enemies, his frenzied attacks will do the trick. Iron Monkey is used by Hector, a tomb raider for the Organization.

entries.title: Unnamed Suit 030
entries.summary: Unnamed Suit 030 is a Suit working with Klaus within in the Organization at the site of the Tomb of Nefertiti in Egypt.

entries.title: Hippolyta
entries.summary: Hippolyta is the young Queen of the Amazons who wore the Ring of Behemoth as a necklace given to her by her mother. Hippolyta's mother is the wife of Metz.

entries.title: Farslip
entries.summary: Farslip is a handy Huntik Foundation spell used to open up doors and break locks. It can also activate traps. Very little energy is used to cast this. When cast it emits a green glow from the user's finger, the glow will then enter the object unlocking it.

entries.title: Chillskin
entries.summary: Chillskin is a shielding spell that creates a barrier of blue energy as protection from fire-based dangers. It is the cold equivalent to the fiery spell Armorburn.

entries.title: Overshield
entries.summary: Overshield is a spell that creates a shield of indigo energy to protect a Seeker or allies from oncoming attacks.

entries.title: Stoneglove
entries.summary: Stoneglove is a spell that coats the caster's hand in a rock-like casing. As such, this spell can be used to amplify a punch or to protect the caster's hand. When manifested, this spell emits a green aura.

entries.title: Blasteater
entries.summary: Blasteater is a defensive spell that manifests as a green aura shaped like a mouth with sharp teeth that opens up to consume oncoming attacks. It is typically used by members of the Organization.

entries.title: Eathon the dog
entries.summary: Eathon is the Professor's dog, whom he named after Eathon Lambert. Though initially suspected that the dog might be the Seeker, Eathon Lambert, who had been converted into a dog by the professor's magic, this information is later shown to be incorrect. After the Professor's defeat, Hoffman took custody of the dog.

entries.title: The Vampire Loses Its Fangs
entries.summary: The Huntik team travel to Romania to recover the Titans of the evil Vlad Dracul. However, Klaus is one step ahead and orders Zhalia, to eliminate the whole team for the good - but can she go through with it?

entries.title: Ladies' Choice
entries.summary: The Huntik team, under Metz' guidance, journeys to Turkey to recover the Ring of Behemoth from the Amazons. After a series of mistaken intentions, the team find themselves pitted against the Amazons. However, the appearance of Rassimov and his men means that the team must intervene. During the conflict, a mysterious figure appears to invoke an ancient rite for leadership of the tribe.

entries.title: Derenzar
entries.summary: Derenzar is a blue, reptilian Draco-Titan that is easily invoked but has been known to turn on its owner. It is an exception to the general rule of Draco-Titans being noble and chivalrous.

entries.title: Like Father, Unlike Son
entries.summary: Leaving Madea Island, Dante and the Huntik team come off course to stop Grier and his Suits from invading Sutos Island. However, the locals do not wish to be free of the Organization or Grier, who is revealed to be the island's rightful prince. Meanwhile, Zhalia investigates the Argo which was sunk in the island's bay and finds the chest of Hoplite Amulets.

entries.title: Wormwalker
entries.summary: Wormwalker is a terrifying Meso-Titan that does not actually have a solid body. Everything under its robes is just a big pile of worms, bugs, and slime.

entries.title: Bellona
entries.summary: Bellona is a Krono-Titan resembling a fierce lion adorned with the armor of an ancient Roman gladiator. The defensive Bellona Titans are also related to the offensive Hoplite Titans.

entries.title: Kallipolitan
entries.summary: Kallipolitan is a Krono-Titan that resembles a cyclops, a one-eyed giant from ancient Greece. He wears a toga instead of the armor of other Krono-Titans.

entries.title: Pastry Café
entries.summary: The pastry café serves pastries, and the player may go to the café to buy a snack due to being hungry. If the player chooses the option that leads to to the cafe, the player hears a suspicious sound again. After that, the player returns to the street from where the noise was heard. [Adventure Game]

entries.title: Dante Vale/Quotes
entries.summary:
"Seekers, we have a mission."
- Dante Vale (recurring)

"Uh, excuse me, is someone there? A little help here, I'm… loaded down with all these groceries. Can someone get the door?"
- Dante Vale, to DeFoe's Suits ("A Seeker Is Born")

"It's time for you guys to go. You can walk away or get thrown away with the trash. Your choice."
- Dante Vale, to DeFoe's Suits ("A Seeker Is Born")

"I warned you."

entries.title: Giantkiller
entries.summary: Giantkiller is a blue, armored Krono-Titan of average build whose sole weapon is a sling with a stone.

entries.title: Sunhawk
entries.summary: Sunhawk is a winged Meso-Titan that is a cousin of Solwing. It is among the strongest of the bird titans and is strong enough to lift other Titans into the air.

entries.title: Hopeshatter
entries.summary: Hopeshatter is a spell which takes a Titan out of battle directly, sending them straight back to their Amulet in a single shot. It is a powerful and deadly spell as it is even able to take out Titans such as Metagolem and Caliban.

entries.title: Soulburn
entries.summary: Soulburn is a Casterwill spell which lets allows the caster to burn up an amount of life force in order to regain energy for spells. It is dangerous, as the spell can cost the caster's life, so Soulburn is rarely used.

entries.title: Sutos Island
entries.summary: Sutos is a desert island located in the Aegean Sea. It was the place where Grier was born and his father, Zan-Sutos, was the king. It is unique for being open to the world of Seekers and Titans, with Seekers even using their powers openly. It was also the spot where Jason sank his ship, the Argo, for good.

entries.title: Castle of Vlad Dracul
entries.summary: The Castle of Vlad Dracul was once the home of Vlad Dracul, also known as Vlad the Impaler, one of the evil Seekers in history. It was here that the wild Titan, Antedeluvian, haunted as well as where the Heart of Vlad Dracul was hidden. Many traps were left to protect the artifacts and secrets of Vlad Dracul.

entries.title: Shadowpoint
entries.summary: Shadowpoint is a power that enables its user to fire a shuriken at a target with great speed and velocity. It is a favored spell of Santiago.

entries.title: Windrush
entries.summary: Windrush is an offensive spell. It creates a channel of air that is fired from the hand and winds toward the target. The spell emits a blue aura with grey spots.

entries.title: The Golden Asp
entries.summary: With the Amulet of Will now in their possession, the gang decides to decipher additional clues from Eathon's journal containing the location of the final two Legendary Titans. The next Legendary Titan is located in Ethopia, Africa, and this time The Professor will personally attend to the issue.

entries.title: All Work and No Pay
entries.summary: The clues the team found in Prague, Czech Republic, are finally returned and lead the team to the Tomb of Nefertiti in Egypt. The Organization decides to make things a little more interesting by eliminating all record of Sophie Casterwill, including her funds, meaning the gang must find jobs to raise funds and make it to Egypt.

entries.title: Season 2
entries.summary: The second season of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers was first broadcast in Italy on September 17th, 2011 on Rai Due. It premiered in the UK on April 16th, 2012 on the CITV network. It premiered in the US on Nicktoons on April 21st, 2013. This season follows Lok's quest to decipher the quatrains of Nostradamus and prevent the end of the world, as Sophie uncovers the truth about the Casterwill family as

entries.title: Janus Knight
entries.summary: Janus Knight is large Draco-Titan who rides a dark-coated steed and is heavily armed with two broadswords.

entries.title: Atlantis
entries.summary: Atlantis is a legendary sunken city submerged beneath the waters of Greece. Historically constructed by the ancient Atlanteans under the guidance of the Casterwill Family, the city serves as a heavily fortified sanctuary and the ultimate resting place of the legendary Amulet of Will. The city is structurally protected from the crushing deep-sea environment by a massive, ancient magical atmospheric

entries.title: Dovhi-tep
entries.summary: Dovhi-tep, an Egyptian general in ancient times, possessed a dozen Redcap Titans himself, and over the course of many years he built up the focus to control them all at once. This army of terrifying Titans led Dovhi-tep to many victories and established his, and Redcap's, reputation as a force with which to be reckoned.

entries.title: Sword of Saint George
entries.summary: The Sword of Saint George is a double-edged sword which was once used by Saint George and held his Titan Lindorm, before the sword was buried in Silene, Libya.

entries.title: Acidheart
entries.summary: Acidheart is a spell used to knock someone someone out by targeting the heart. This spell manifests as a spherical aura on the hand which emits a wavelike stream of green energy.

entries.title: Darksleep
entries.summary: Darksleep is a spell that cause the target to fall asleep or to lose consciousness. During casting, caster's eyes glow violet while the hand is engulfed by a violet mist, which then surrounds the victim.

entries.title: The Mission
entries.summary: With Dante in a shocked and vulnerable state after being tricked by the Professor, Lok leads the team into a final battle with the Professor as they try and prevent him from invoking the Legendary Titan of Immortality. But sacrifices have to be made...
