entries.title: Golden Asp
entries.summary: The Golden Asp was large structure carved as a serpent and served as the entrance to King Solomon's mines. The Golden Asp was guarded by the three Titan colossi: Ashtoreth, Chemosh, and Milcom. Pressing the eye of the serpent would open the doors but would also wake the colossi.

entries.title: Lucas Casterwill
entries.summary: Lucas Casterwill is the older brother of Sophie Casterwill. He became orphaned at a young age when his parents were killed due to a massive fire at their mansion in Paris caused by Kiel, a member of the Blood Spiral.

entries.title: Den Fears
entries.summary: Den Fears is a courageous young orphan and the older brother of Harrison Fears. Forced to join the Blood Spiral with his brother, Den quickly saw through their cruel ideals and walked away, joining the Huntik Foundation and pitting himself against Harrison, who stayed with the Spirals. Den subsequently joined Dante's team as a replacement for Zhalia Moon when she left to infiltrate the Blood Spira

entries.title: Januseea the Gatekeeper
entries.summary: Januseea the Gatekeeper is a masked Meso-Titan with exceptional inter-dimensional capabilities. Her appearance is that of a crossed-legged humanoid figure, surrounded by floating blue orbs capable of redirecting attacks. Januseea's Amulet is in the possession of Zhalia Moon.

entries.title: Harlekin
entries.summary: Harlekin are the principle Titans used by the Silent Soldiers of the Blood Spiral. According to Tantras, fear is necessary to bond with Harlekin in contrast to the rage which is necessary to bond with Marauder. Within the Blood Spiral, Harlekin and Marauder are like the Redcap and Mindrone Titans of the Organization.

entries.title: Vigilante
entries.summary: Vigilante is an assassin-like Draco-Titan whose face and body are covered by a flowing cloak. Vigilante once belonged to an evil Seeker, would therefore only bond to someone with a strong dark side, and that is why, after his Amulet came into the possession of the Huntik Foundation, Vigilante became the primary Titan of the orphan, Den Fears.

entries.title: Umbra
entries.summary: Umbra the Shadow Jaguar is the Legendary Titan of Dimensions. As such, Umbra has the ability of teleportation. This black jaguar Titan bears orange and cream armor to protect his body.

entries.title: Sorcerel
entries.summary: Sorcerel is a magic-orientated Draco-Titan who specializes in spell casting, ranging from offensive magical blasts to defensive force barriers. With her golden helmet and long flowing pink hair, her appearance resembles that of an ancient sorceress. Once a favored Titan of the Casterwill family seer, Nostradamus, Sorcerel is now a primary Titan of Sophie Casterwill alongside her combat-focused Tit

entries.title: Marauder
entries.summary: Marauder is one of the principle Titans used by the Silent Soldiers of the Blood Spiral. Marauder's body is enveloped in a dark cloak and his face is covered by a strange mask. Marauder and Harlekin are together used like the Redcap and Mindrone Titans used by the Organization. Like Harlekin, Marauder draws power on its Seeker's negative emotions, especially rage. He is related to another Titan kn

entries.title: Silent Soldiers
entries.summary: The Silent Soldiers are the lowest level minions of Blood Spiral as initiates into the group. They each wear a mask, and hooded gray uniforms with red trim, which designate them as being below Kiel's trained team of Casterwill Hunters. They regularly appear in large groups, each educated to strictly follow the Blood Spiral's laws and to view the world simply as prey for the Nullifiers, who would f

entries.title: Ironsquire
entries.summary: Ironsquire is an amber and steel-blue robotic Titan that is closely related to Freelancer. Bearing a large shield, Ironsquire specializes in defense. This Titan is used by members of the Huntik Foundation, notably Lok Lambert and Clements.

entries.title: Quetzalcoatl
entries.summary: Quetzalcoatl is the Legendary Titan of Summons whose power was sealed away in the Pyramid of the Sun in Mexico. As part of an ancient signal to call together the scattered members of the Casterwill family from across the world, Quetzalcoatl can transform into a celestial body known as the Blue Star, shining out across the Earth from space.

entries.title: Medusa
entries.summary: Medusa is a rare and coveted Krono-Titan that terrorized Ancient Greece. With a human-like torso and the tail of a serpent, her hair forms a large snake head and, like King Basilisk, she can turn her enemies to stone with her gaze. An exceptionally volatile and unruly Titan, no Seeker had been successful in taming Medusa for two thousand years.

entries.title: Pendragon
entries.summary: Pendragon is the Legendary Titan of Champions, whose Amulet was housed inside the Willblade, the legendary Casterwill sword of Avalon. As the Legendary Titan of Champions, Pendragon's Seeker must be a champion chosen directly by Lord Casterwill. Pendragon has now become Powerbonded to the current champion, Lok Lambert, having unlocked his true power during his final battle against The Betrayer.

entries.title: Mythras
entries.summary: Mythras is the Legendary Titan of Valor. He resembles a blue, lion-like centauroid with hair of blue-hot flames. He rides into battle with golden, plate-mail armor adorned with red gems. Mythras will only bond with someone with a courageous heart, and, as such, his Ring was the prize of the Casterwill family's Trial of Courage.

entries.title: Arc
entries.summary: Arc, the Legendary Titan of Fate, is sealed inside the Ring of Arc. Due to her unstable behavior, it is said that no Seeker is able to control this Titan. The only Seeker in recorded history to have been able to bond with and control this Titan was Joan of Arc.

entries.title: Willblade
entries.summary: The Willblade is a Legendary item of the Casterwill family. It contains the amulet of Pendragon in the center, which can be extracted only if the puzzle is completed. Lok Lambert pulled the Willblade out of a stone on Avalon island and bonded with the blade.

entries.title: Gremlow
entries.summary: Gremlow is a rat-like Titan with the ability to create a swarm of clones out of itself. Though weak on its own, this Swarm ability allows this Titan to overwhelm larger, more powerful Titans through its sheer numbers. It was the basis of the invading rats of legend that were led away from Hamelin, Germany, by the Pied Piper.

entries.title: Raijin the Thunderbolt
entries.summary: Raijin the Thunderbolt is a blue-skinned Yama-Titan swordsman with electrical power. His elf-like appearance and long, green hair give him a similar appearance to that of Kunoichi, a female Yama-Titan. Raijin's Amulet is under the ownership of Lok Lambert.

entries.title: Elf King Oberon
entries.summary: Elf King Oberon is a pale-skinned Gaia-Titan who wields a traditional Elven leaf-like sword. Donning a golden mask and red cape, he is a majestic swordsman who can create dazzling spheres of yellow energy. Oberon's Amulet is under the ownership of Dante Vale.

entries.title: Kaioh the Tracker
entries.summary: Kaioh the Tracker is a Meso-Titan dressed in wooden armor with a headdress that resembles that of a Native American Indian tribal chief. Wielding a large wooden medicine stick and a long green vine, Kaioh specializes in location skills and seeking out hidden objects. This Titan was given to Den Fears by Teeg, a Native Kumeyaay Seeker.

entries.title: Cursed Archer
entries.summary: Cursed Archer is a skull-emblazoned Draco-Titan that specializes in ranged attacks. Despite his menacing, almost demonic appearance, Cursed Archer is used for good purposes by the Huntik Foundation. His Amulet was given to Den Fears by the Huntik Foundation Council.

entries.title: Void
entries.summary: Void was the first Nullifier in ancient to history to arrive on Earth and was responsible for the creation of the Spiral Mark. Although originally thought by some Seekers to be a Titan himself, Void is in fact a Nullifier, contained in a unique Amulet, a blue crystal shard with an evil, red aura. While Void would be considered to be colossal when compared to the Titans, he is merely a small scout

entries.title: Harrison Fears
entries.summary: Harrison Fears is the orphaned younger brother of Den Fears. While Harrison chose to join with the Blood Spiral Brotherhood, his brother, Den, sided with the Huntik Foundation. Due to their conflicting factions and outlooks, the two brothers became heated rivals until the final battle against the Betrayer where, after much soul-searching, Harrison switched sides.

entries.title: Gigadrone
entries.summary: Gigadrone is a flying, insectoid Swara-Titan with six appendages, four of which serve as arms. Able to fire laser blasts from his eyes, this Titan is commonly used alongside Venomaster by Mr. Wilder's Suits, serving a similar purpose to the Mindrone and Enforcer Titans by specializing in ranged aerial attacks.

entries.title: Hitokiri
entries.summary: Hitokiri is a quick and agile warrior with the face of an Oni. He has red skin and dresses in samurai armor. This Titan utilizes a deadly katana and can often rely on his considerable speed and Japanese fighting techniques in battle.

entries.title: Venomaster
entries.summary: Venomaster is a cobra-like Swara-Titan that epitomizes the legends of reptile men. Carrying a resistant and flexible snake-tail whip made from his own skin, Venomaster is both an adept close combat fighter and ranged attacker, spitting cobra venom at its enemies. This Titan is commonly used by Mr. Wilder's Suits alongside Gigadrone.

entries.title: Mr. Wilder
entries.summary: Mr. Wilder was the successor of the Professor and was the second leader of the Organization. Wilder characteristically wears his blonde hair styled up, and he wears a white suit like his predecessor. His two righthand men while leading the Organization were Hoffman, who also had served the Professor, and Stack.

entries.title: Incubane
entries.summary: Incubane is a demonic Yama-Titan with goat-like horns and feet who is capable of shooting laser beams from its nails. An Incubane Titan is the primary Titan of Mr. Wilder.

entries.title: Divine Mirror Kagami
entries.summary: Divine Mirror Kagami is a floating mirror Yama-Titan dressed in a red robe with long flowing veridian hair. Kagami's Amulet was found by Hoffman and Eathon the dog in a cave in the Japanese Chu-Goku Mount. It was given to Mr. Wilder who later gave it to Stack to use in infiltrating the Blood Spiral.

entries.title: Bladecall
entries.summary: Bladecall is a spell which allows the caster to summon a magical sword known as the Willblade. This spell is now used by Lok Lambert, the Champion of Casterwill and current wielder of the Willblade.

entries.title: Vulcana
entries.summary: Vulcana is a robed Yama-Titan whose body is composed of molten material and whose hair is made of fire. Gliding through the air with the utmost maneuverability, she is capable of controlling the element of fire. Vulcana is the primary Titan of the explosive Blood Spiral fanatic, Kiel.

entries.title: Balenpyre
entries.summary: Balenpyre is a large, golem-like Litho-Titan possessing a single, large eye on its demon-horned head. Its body is composed of vulcanic rock and lava. Balenpyre's Amulet is in the possession of Kiel.

entries.title: Sentry Triclops
entries.summary: Sentry Triclops is an extremely strong Titan used by powerful Seekers as a guard for their secrets. These three-eyed Titans are large, golem-like Litho-Titans which possess immense offensive and defensive capabilities. Nostradamus left three of them at the Tower of Nostradamus to guard his tower's secret room, and Zhalia Moon fought one in Nikola Tesla's workshop in the past.

entries.title: Nimue Casterwill
entries.summary: Nimue Casterwill, also known as the Lady of the Lake, was a member of the Casterwill family and the elder of the House of Weapons Makers. She also preserved the Casterwill Crystal Caves, which after her death became the responsibility of her granddaughter, Vivian Casterwill.

entries.title: Vivian Casterwill
entries.summary: Vivian Casterwill is the granddaughter of Nimue Casterwill. After the death of Nimue, Vivian became the new Lady of the Lake and the owner of the Legendary Titan of Valor, Mythras.

entries.title: Teien Casterwill
entries.summary: Teien Casterwill is one of the Elders of the Casterwill family, over the House of Strategists, and served as the intermediary between the Huntik Foundation Council and the Casterwill family. Unlike most members of the Casterwill family, Teien is of Japanese descent.

entries.title: Focauld Casterwill
entries.summary: Focauld Casterwill is an elder of the Casterwill family. As the Elder of Knowledge, he lives in the Cloisters in New York where he maintained a Casterwill base. An unyielding traditionalist, Focauld can at first come across as stubborn and arrogant but he deeply cares for his family's preservation.

entries.title: Knowledgelock
entries.summary: Knowledgelock is a Casterwill spell that transforms the information in a library and seals it in a Cypherdex crystal.

entries.title: Heart of Vlad Dracul
entries.summary:
The Heart of Vlad Dracul is a very powerful and evil item that contains the power of Vlad Dracul.

The Blood Spiral Brotherhood tried to retrieve the Heart and use its power to open the mark of the spiral before the longest night of the year but failed thanks to the Huntik team lead by Lok Lambert for the first time. Tantras' attempt to absorb and use its power ultimately backfires on him, gravell

entries.title: Copykind
entries.summary: Copykind is a powerful spell that allows the Seeker to borrow the special abilities of allied Titans. It is the strongest power of Master Storm.

entries.title: Conquistador
entries.summary: Conquistador is a tall, clockwork Meso-Titan that is adept at guarding treasures. His red and gold armor resembles traditional Spanish garb. Conquistador was used by Hernán Cortés, one of the Spanish conquistadores.

entries.title: Kiel
entries.summary: Kiel was a high level member of the Blood Spiral team known as the Casterwill Hunters. Along with his tracker, Marduk, he was responsible for the eradication of numerous Casterwill branches, including the parents of Sophie and Lucas Casterwill, whose home he burnt down. Kiel's choice Titans and spells were typically fire-related, matching his explosive disposition and hot temper. As the most bruta

entries.title: Tantras
entries.summary: Tantras was one of the core members of the Blood Spiral and its Blooded Circle alongside Wind and Shauna and ranked under only Rassimov. His task was to recruit and train new members for the Blood Spiral Brotherhood, and he was sometimes sent on special missions. He both raised and trained the fanatic Kiel, and later became a parental figure for Harrison Fears.

entries.title: The Betrayer
entries.summary: The Betrayer was an immensely powerful and evil Seeker who was responsible for inaugurating the Blood Spiral. Once the best friend of Lord Casterwill, he betrayed the former's sons and daughters by allying himself with Nullifiers with the intent to erase all life on Earth. For years, his spirit gave orders to Rassimov to be carried out by his chaotic followers, before finally resurrecting as a cor

entries.title: Stack
entries.summary: Stack was a high-ranking member of the Organization, operating as the trusted right-hand man to Mr. Wilder. A highly skilled strategist and an accomplished spy, he handled tactical operations and ambushes for Mr. Wilder's team as they attempted to seize control of the faction following the the Professor's defeat.

entries.title: Efreet King
entries.summary: Efreet King is a devastating fire-based Litho-Titan that resembles a horned Djinn-like demon whose body is composed of rock and flame. The ultimate destructive Titan belonging to Kiel, Efreet King is one of the few known standard Titans that can fight toe-to-toe with the Legendary Titans.

entries.title: Jericho
entries.summary: Jericho the head of monks is a powerful flying Hecto-Titan whose appearance is that of a large skeleton abbot made up of long, protruding bones. Jericho was the primary Titan of Tantras, a senior member of the Blood Spiral Brotherhood, before his Amulet was passed on to Harrison Fears.

entries.title: Hoffman
entries.summary: Hoffman is a high-level member of the Organization who served under Mr. Wilder and previously under the Professor himself. He may be old, Hoffman is an experienced Seeker with a strong resoluteness and sets the example for younger members of the Organization to follow.

entries.title: Dark Dryad
entries.summary: Dark Dryad is a Krono-Titan with green skin and golden armor who specializes in nature-based attacks with her control over roots and vines. Dark Dryad is the primary Titan of Stack, a member of the Organization.

entries.title: Wildwood Druid
entries.summary: Wildwood Druid is a humanoid Gaia-Titan who has the appearance of a walking tree with roots for legs, similar to Gybolg. A number of branches grow from her back, and she wears red and gold Celtic vestments. Wildwood Druid is the principal Titan belonging to Lane.

entries.title: Lane
entries.summary: Lane is one of the members of Lucas Casterwill's team along with Dellix. Although more calm and subdued than her teammates, Lane won't hesitate to stand up for what she thinks is right and help out her fellow Seekers in battle.

entries.title: Dellix
entries.summary: Dellix is one of the members of Lucas Casterwill's team along with Lane. A loyal defender of the Casterwill family and skilled swordsman, Dellix won't hesitate to help his brothers and sisters in battle even if it means disobeying his superior.

entries.title: Undine
entries.summary: Undine the Water Spirit is a Krono-Titan whose body is made up of water, the medium through which she can make attacks and conjure whirlpools. She was the primary Titan of Nimue Casterwill, the former Lady of the Lake.

entries.title: Fortress of Iron Will
entries.summary: The Fortress of Iron Will is a Casterwill family stronghold located in the Great Rift Valley of Africa. The Casterwill Elders meet here to discuss the family's decisive moves. The Stronghold houses many Icarus and Feyone Titans, and a single Coralgolem Titan, within its statues as a weapon to defend the stronghold, when activated through a long ritual. The deep networks of the fortress also houses

entries.title: Bazela's Hive
entries.summary: Bazela's Hive is a grotesque, insectoid Swara-Titan that possesses five large, red eyes. From its tail, it is able to summon a swarm of smaller Bazela's Insect Titans. Bazela's Hive was one of most powerful Titans of the Blood Spiral Seeker, Tantras, and was passed on to Harrison Fears before falling into the hands of the Betrayer.

entries.title: Templar
entries.summary: Templar is a red-and-gold armored Gaia-Titan. His face masked behind an armored helmet like the Caliban Titans, he is a fierce swordsman in battle. A mane of long, green hair flows down to his knees. His Amulet is in the possession of Lucas Casterwill.

entries.title: Battleforge
entries.summary: Battleforge is a summoning spell which allows the caster to summon a magical weapon for an ally.

entries.title: Armorforge
entries.summary: Armorforge is a spell which allows the caster to summon a magic shield.

entries.title: Sacroblade
entries.summary: Sacredblade is an extremely powerful spell that creates a forceful wall of blue light that can reflect enemy attacks and send Titans to their Amulets.

entries.title: Newfury
entries.summary: Newfury is a spell used by members of the Blood Spiral Brotherhood to restore energy and to give the user more agility, allowing for quick movements.

entries.title: Underfear
entries.summary: Underfear is a mental spell used to increase the dark emotions of a Seeker, including rage and fear. Tantras uses this power to enable his trainee Seekers to bond with and summon darker-natured Titans.

entries.title: Phoenix
entries.summary: Phoenix is the Legendary Titan of Rebirth. Her Ring was hidden on a volcanic Indonesian island in the lava of Phoenix Volcano, protected by the anti-magic field of the Lodestone.

entries.title: Rearview
entries.summary:
Rearview is a spell that allows Seekers to visualise behind them without turning their heads. On the downside, the Seeker is temporarily unable to see what is in front of them, which might result in the Seeker walking into something.

When a Seeker uses Rearview, their eyes glow blue. A pair of mystical eyes appears on the back of their head. The scene behind them appears to the user within a blue

entries.title: Cerberus
entries.summary: Cerberus is a three-headed, dog-like Titan who has flames for fur along with sharp teeth that can rip enemies apart and claws that are sharp enough to pin enemies down, making it a very dangerous Titan. Cerberus Amulets are in the possession of Marduk and Rahmas.

entries.title: Marduk
entries.summary: Marduk is a member of the Blood Spiral and serves as Kiel's tracker. Whereas Kiel brings the firepower, Marduk brings the stealth to their operations. His Blood Spiral mark is located on his right shoulder and is normally covered by his shirt, further assisting his going unnoticed.

entries.title: Clements
entries.summary: Clements is a researcher working for the Huntik Foundation at his station in a secret Foundation base located within the Cathedral of Notre Dame. He was taken hostage by the Legendary Titan of Fate, Arc, but was rescued by the Huntik team.

entries.title: Galen
entries.summary: Galen is a Native Kumeyaay Huntik Foundation archaeologist based in Baja California, Mexico. He and his brother, Teeg, are both experts on the famous conqueror, Hernán Cortés.

entries.title: Teeg
entries.summary: Teeg is a Native Kumeyaay Huntik Foundation Seeker based in Baja California, Mexico. As an archaeologist, he and his brother, Galen, are experts on Hernán Cortés.

entries.title: Thornstaff
entries.summary: Thornstaff is a spell that enables the user to transform an object into a staff-like weapon.

entries.title: Nullcurse
entries.summary: Nullcurse is the signature spell of the Silent Soldiers in the Blood Spiral. This spell creates a bolt of blood-red energy that can be fired from the hand or used for close combat. It is one of few known spells to be able break through the Casterwill family's Honorguard spell.

entries.title: Stormflare
entries.summary: Stormflare is a fire-based spell used by members of the Blood Spiral. The spell acts much like a magical flame-thrower coming from the user's hand, producing a beam of orange fire.

entries.title: Armorburn
entries.summary: Armorburn is a fiery spell that creates a burning red aura around the user. This aura inflicts burns to anything or anyone touching it. It is the fire equivalent to the cold spell Chillskin, which is regularly used to counter Armorburn. This spell is used by Kiel.

entries.title: Fireswarm
entries.summary: Fireswarm is a fire-based attack that manifests as a series of dark embers surrounded by a violet aura. This spell is similar in functionality to the Firestorm spell.

entries.title: The Sceptre Deception
entries.summary: The team takes on a mission that Guggenheim makes official: The Tomb of Nefertiti . They retrieve the map, but Zhalia Moon plays them right into the Organization's hands. Will the Organization get the sceptre - which is the key to conquering the world?

entries.title: The Bookshop Hunter
entries.summary: Following Klaus back to Vienna, the team close in on his base but it is rigged with traps. Dante devises a surprise of his own while Sophie begins to suspect that there is a traitor amongst them.

entries.title: Lilith the Queen
entries.summary: Lilith the Queen is a demonic Hecto-Titan who takes the form of an Egyptian queen. Her ten mummified legs and bat-like wings grant her speed both in the air and on the ground. She is the strongest Titan in the possession of Shauna.

entries.title: Fireport
entries.summary: Fireport is a spell used to teleport short distances in a burst of flames. Upon teleportation, the burning aura remains for a while.

entries.title: Doberman
entries.summary: Doberman is a dog-like Titan in the possession of Hoffman. A strong fighter with eyes that shine with energy, Doberman dons a sturdy obsidian armor with bronze decorations. Lightning fast and snappy like a wolf, only a madman could even hope to dodge one of his attacks.

entries.title: Grand Façade
entries.summary: Grand Façade is a defensive, blue-skinned Meso-Titan. His strong armor is impregnable, and long hair covers his one weak spot on his back. In contrast to his tribal-style armor, he wears a futuristic, red visor on his face. Grand Façade is used by Mr. Wilder as his secret weapon.

entries.title: Logosbook
entries.summary: Logosbook is a spell that allows the caster to communicate with another Seeker using a book. One Seeker writes in the book, and the message appears in the other book.

entries.title: Bladewave
entries.summary: Bladewave is a spell that creates a series of powerful black blades of energy. This spell is similar to the Bladestorm and Darkwave spells, also used by the Blood Spiral.

entries.title: Zhalia Moon's apartment
entries.summary: Zhalia's apartment was where Zhalia Moon stayed while living in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

entries.title: Venomhand
entries.summary: Venomhand is an offensive spell. It creates a green aura of venom around the user's hand. This spell is often used by Zhalia Moon and high-ranking members of the Organization. It is deadly and is often used to eliminate people for good.

entries.title: The Professor's castle
entries.summary: The Professor's castle is the castle where the Professor used to live. In addition to Organization Central, the Professor's castle was, and remained, one of the main bases of the Organization.

entries.title: Midnight Rook
entries.summary: Midnight Rook is a flying Litho-Titan with a grey head and breast, and wings as dark as its name suggests. This expeditious Titan is deft at tracking and spying on its enemies, all the while retaining an unnerving solidarity and covertness. With razor-sharp talons and even sharper eyes, this Titan is primarily used by Marduk and the Casterwill Hunters of the Blood Spiral.

entries.title: Myrmidon
entries.summary: Myrmidon is a Krono-Titan whose muscular body is donned with red clothes and gold armor in the style of an ancient Greek warrior. He is equipped with a clawed gauntlet on his left hand and wields a sword for combat. A Myrmidon Amulet is in the possession of Hoffman.

entries.title: Shadow Agent
entries.summary: Shadow Agent is a hooded Swara-Titan who wields a scythe-like axe. He bears green and blue armor which is equipped with large, sharp spines. As a Titan used by the Organization, Shadow Agent is typically paired alongside Doom Warden.

entries.title: Doom Warden
entries.summary: Doom Warden is a shadowy, reptilian Titan with green skin and blue armor. This burly Titan wields a giant key as its primary weapon. Doom Warden was in the possession of Mr. Wilder until he gave it to one of his Suits.

entries.title: Ironhand
entries.summary: Ironhand is a spell that coats the caster's hand in a metallic casing that can be used for protection or to amplify a punch. When manifested, this spell emits a yellow aura.

entries.title: Neverlost
entries.summary: Neverlost is a spell that permits its user to detect energy radiating from hidden amulets.

entries.title: Cutrace
entries.summary: Cutrace is a basic spell used by the Blood Spiral and is comparable to the Hyperstride spell. This spell increases the caster's speed and agility, permitting quick escape, sudden strikes during combat, and an increased jump distance. The spell manifests itself as a purple to red aura surrounding the caster's legs.

entries.title: Blood Spiral Base
entries.summary: The Blood Spiral Base is the main headquarters of the Blood Spiral, located in a desert region of the Central Siberian Plateau, on top of the original site of the Spiral Mark. The location of the Blood Spiral Base was unknown until Zhalia Moon infiltrated the Blood Spiral and was able to reveal the location to Dante Vale through a sketch using Logosbook.

entries.title: Basilisk House
entries.summary: Basilisk House is a large bulding in Vienna, Austria, and the former resting place of King Basilisk's Amulet which was hidden deep within. A unique key was required to enter and map was needed to navigate its corridors.

entries.title: Spittelberg
entries.summary: Spittelberg is the site of a Huntik Foundation Safehouse in Vienna, Austria.

entries.title: Maelstrom
entries.summary: Maelstrom is a Gaia-Titan genie, whose torso resembles that of a green-skinned human while his lower portion is like a tornado of whirling winds, much like that of Powerbonded Ariel using his Hyperstrike ability. Crackling with energy, in his hands floats a powerful vortex capable of absorbing the powers of nearby enemies. Maelstrom's Amulet is in the possession of Dante Vale.

entries.title: Legion
entries.summary: Legion is the dark Legendary Titan of War, whose power allows him to absorb other Titans and use their powers at his own will. Once the Titan of the Betrayer, he was given to Rassimov and hidden deep within his body to be used as his secret weapon.

entries.title: Tomb of Nefertiti
entries.summary: The Tomb of Nefertiti is a burial site located in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt. It once contained the Sceptre of Nefertiti, a magical artifact containing the power Neverlost. It also contained the Key of Nefertiti which could unlock the Tomb of Tutankhamun.

entries.title: Tomb of Tutankhamun
entries.summary: The Tomb of Tutankhamun is the tomb of the renowned pharaoh Tutankhamun. The secret entrance of the tomb can be opened only with the Key of Nefertiti, a special key located in the Tomb of Nefertiti.

entries.title: Necklace of Tutankhamun
entries.summary: The Necklace of Tutankhumun was an ancient magical artifact that could supposedly control the Nullifiers.

entries.title: Sceptre of Nefertiti
entries.summary: The Sceptre of Nefertiti was an ancient artifact that contained the spell Neverlost. It was buried in the Tomb of Nefertiti before falling into the hands of the Organization.

entries.title: Firbolg
entries.summary: Firbolg the Fierce Giant was one of the guardian Titans of the magical floating castle of Tír na nÓg alongside Dullahan the headless knight. His Amulet is currently in the possession of Scarlet Byrne.

entries.title: Dullahan
entries.summary: Dullahan the Headless Knight was one of the guardian Titans of the magical floating castle of Tír na nÓg alongside Firbolg the fierce giant. His Amulet is currently in the possession of Den Fears.

entries.title: Lambert house
entries.summary: The Lambert house is located in Ireland and was where Sandra and Eathon Lambert raised their children, Lok and Kathy.

entries.title: Paris Catacombs
entries.summary: The Paris Catacombs are a large network of underground tunnels that extend deep beneath the city of Paris. Joan of Arc hid the Ring of Arc here where it remained for many centuries until it was recovered by the Huntik Foundation.

entries.title: Inter-dimensional World
entries.summary: The Inter-dimensional World is a limbo-like world between the human dimension and the Spirit World.

entries.title: Tír na nÓg
entries.summary: Tír na nÓg is a magical castle floating over Ireland. The castle is visible and physical only under the light of a full moon. The castle is guarded by Firbolg and Dullahan Titans.

entries.title: Master Storm
entries.summary: Master Storm is a master of martial arts who taught Dante Vale in his youth. The grandfather of Lin Storm and an old friend of Metz, he lives in the Taihang Mountains of China.

entries.title: Lin Storm
entries.summary: Lin Storm is the granddaughter of Master Storm and a childhood friend of Dante Vales's, who lives in the Taihang Mountains of China.

entries.title: Powerscan
entries.summary: Powerscan is a spell that allow the users to sense a presence of a spell or a Seeker artifact in the area.

entries.title: The Secret of Two Generations
entries.summary: The Huntik team searches for information about Simon Judeau and the Legendary Titan Araknos. After a discussion with Metz, espionage in the Organization Headquarters, and research in the Huntik Foundation library, the team makes a critical discovery about the identity of the Professor.

entries.title: Coming of Age
entries.summary: The Huntik team travels to Atlantis on their quest for the Amulet of Will. Lok starts to become stronger and show his true potential. The team finds Atlantis, but four tests await them.

entries.title: Memory Lane
entries.summary:
Vlad's Castle, Romania

The Huntik team searches Vlad Dracul's Castle in order to lay hand on Titans which once belonged to evil Count Vlad, but the team splits and Klaus orders Zhalia to get rid of its members one by one. When all hope seems lost, Zhalia repents for her betrayal, leaving the Organization for good and helping our heroes.

entries.title: The Divine Comedy
entries.summary: Having lost the journal and the Amulet of Will, the Huntik team heads to Prague to confront the Professor on his home turf.

entries.title: Firestorm
entries.summary: Firestorm is a fire-based spell that functions like a flamethrower. When casting this spell, a sphere of white energy surrounds the user's hand before forming a long stream of flames. This spell is similar in functionality to the Fireswarm spell.

entries.title: Oathmaker
entries.summary: Oathmaker is a psychic spell used by Teien Casterwill that forces the target to tell the truth to the caster. The spell forces the target say what he or she considers the truth, not necessarily the actual truth. In this regard, it is much like the spell version of a truth serum. This spell can even be used long distances with a Tome.

entries.title: Strikemode
entries.summary: Strikemode is a spell used by Klaus to make the spell's target become stronger. The spell manifests as a red and yellow ball of goo-like energy that is launched at the intended target.

entries.title: Overmode
entries.summary: Overmode is a modified version of Strikemode created by Klaus. Through firing a reddish, goo-like energy, the targeted Seeker is transformed into a larger, more powerful creature.

entries.title: Psikofen
entries.summary: Psikofen is a mummy-like Hecto-Titan who, through the use of its deadly chains that come out of its hands, can ensnare enemies or violently tear through solid structures, making him a dangerous and formidable opponent. Closely related to the Titan Marauder, Psikofen is used by Marduk and the Casterwill Hunters of the Blood Spiral.

entries.title: Kelpie
entries.summary: Kelpie is an armored and aquatic horse-like Gaia-Titan possessing a mane and tail of water and razor-sharp fins on its legs. Possessing gils on its neck, it is capable of fighting both on land or in water. Kelpie's Amulet is in the possession of Sophie Casterwill..

entries.title: Helinx
entries.summary: Helinx is a demonic, cat-like Yama-Titan that bears blue armor. Its body is covered by a number of bony spikes. This Titan is used by Marduk.

entries.title: Huntik Foundation Italian HQ
entries.summary: The Huntik Foundation Italian HQ, formerly known as the Huntik Foundation Compound, is the main base for the Huntik Foundation in Venice, Italy. It contains a large library and a training ring, used for teaching new Seekers. Klaus was kept in the basement here during his time as a statue.

entries.title: Organization Central
entries.summary: Organization Central is the principal headquarters of the Organization, located in Prague, Czech Republic. The archives store an impressive array of information and arcane artifacts obtained since the Organization's creation by Simon Judeau in 1959. The Professor would often summon his subordinates to his office, located here, and berate them if they had failed in their missions. Providing accommo

entries.title: Otto
entries.summary: Otto is a desert guide who lives in Mek'ele in Ethiopia. He is a good friend of Zhalia Moon, having worked as a guide for her while she was a member of the Organization.

entries.title: Otto's house
entries.summary: Otto's house is where Otto lives, near Mek'ele in Ethiopia.

entries.title: Mek'ele Airport
entries.summary: Mek'ele Airport is a crowded airport located in Mek'ele, Ethiopia.

entries.title: Madea Island
entries.summary: Madea Island is an island located in an unknown location in the Aegean Sea at the center of the Atlantic Ocean. For many years it was home to the Titan, Madea, which is known for its illusions.

entries.title: Cristine
entries.summary: Cristine was an illusion of a woman who lived on Madea Island, created by the Titan Madea. She claimed that her family's responsibility was to guard the Casterwill family legacy and bring Sophie Casterwill to the island's Casterwill Library. After Sophie studied the books in the library, she discovered that they were vague and contradict each other. Realizing that Cristine and the library were mer

entries.title: Kunoichi
entries.summary: Kunoichi is a four-eyed, ninja-warrior Yama-Titan. She wears blue and red armor and has long blue hair. Armed with a katana, Kunoichi is a fast and agile fighter. A Kunoichi Amulet is in the possession of Santiago.

entries.title: Demigorgan
entries.summary: Demigorgan is the Legendary Titan of Betrayal and is the personal Titan of the Betrayer. While its true appearance is that of a huge goat-dog hybrdi with orange armor and disproportionately large arms, Demigorgan is able to alter its form at will to anything it has touched, at its Seeker's demand.

entries.title: Champion of Casterwill
entries.summary: The first Champion of Casterwill was a master Seeker who fought on behalf of Lord Casterwill in battle and was the previous owner of Pendragon, the Legendary Titan of Champions. The title of champion was later supposedly taken on by Lok Lambert.

entries.title: Elder son of Casterwill
entries.summary: The elder son of Casterwill was one of Lord Casterwill's children and the previous Seeker to be bonded to Umbra, the Legendary Titan of Dimensions.

entries.title: Elder daughter of Casterwill
entries.summary: The elder daughter of Casterwill was the first Lady of the Lake and previous owner of Quetzalcoatl, the Legendary Titan of Summons.

entries.title: Younger son of Casterwill
entries.summary: The younger son of Casterwill was one of Lord Casterwill's children and the previous Seeker bonded to Mythras, the Legendary Titan of Valour .

entries.title: Younger daughter of Casterwill
entries.summary: The younger daughter of Casterwill was one of Lord Casterwill's children and the previous Seeker bonded to Phoenix, the Legendary Titan of Rebirth.

entries.title: Paris Casterwill house
entries.summary: The Paris Casterwill house was the former house of Sophie Casterwill, Lucas Casterwill, and Santiago, perched atop a hill in Montmorency, Paris, France.

entries.title: Melee Artist
entries.summary: Melee Artist is the pink-haired Titan of Billie, one of the three Huntik Foundation operatives working in the museum of Nostradamus' tower. This Titan has four arms, each equipped with a golden sword.

entries.title: Temple of Poseidon
entries.summary: The Temple of Poseidon is the only entrance to Atlantis, the sunken city. It is one of the six temples built by the Atlanteans, and the only one to rest upon the surface, serving as a gateway to the city in ancient times. Its ruins are located somewhere along the Greek coast of the Aegean Sea.

entries.title: Bottle of Djinn
entries.summary: The Bottle of Djinn used to hold the amulet of an unknown Titan.

entries.title: Bazela's Insect
entries.summary: Bazela's Insects are Swara-Titan fliers summoned by the Bazela's Hive Titan. Many Bazela's Insects may be deployed from a single mother Titan to transport Seekers across the globe or carry them into the heart of battle.

entries.title: Iceland Airport
entries.summary: is a small airport located in Iceland.

entries.title: Complaining customer
entries.summary: The complaining customer is a non-Seeker who ordered a double cappuccino in a coffeehouse of Venice, Italy. He complained to Sophie Casterwill, who was temporarily working there at the time, that his double cappuccino was not hot enough, calling her a dimwit for this action. Lok Lambert reacted by using a Boltflare spell on the cappuccino, after which the customer burned his tongue. This event is

entries.title: Venice coffeehouse
entries.summary: The Venice coffeehouse is a café located in Venice, Italy, which sells several types of coffee, alcoholic beverages, and cakes. Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Cherit worked here for a short time as they were trying to earn money for plane tickets to Egypt. [All Work and No Pay]

entries.title: Alisa Clairmont
entries.summary: Alisa Clairmont is a rich and ill-mannered woman who visits Venice, Italy every year from France. She attempted to reserve a room in the Venice Hotel for her and her dog but became angry at Sophie Casterwill when she was politely told that the East penthouse was already occupied.

entries.title: Alisa Clairmont's dog
entries.summary: Alisa Clairmont's dog is a dog that belongs to Alisa Clairmont. According to Alisa Clairmont, her dog can sense when people who don't like dogs, whom he then bites, and tt was purported to be for this reason that he bit both Lok and LeBlanche.

entries.title: Venice Hotel
entries.summary: The is a hotel located in Venice, Italy.

entries.title: Gondolier
entries.summary: The gondolier is an unnamed man who acts as a gondolier in Venice, Italy. He has been knocked into the canal from his gondola by Lok Lambert on two separate occasions.

entries.title: Hippolyta's mother
entries.summary: Hippolyta's mother was an Amazon queen and the wife of Metz. Her status as a Seeker is currently unknown.

entries.title: Slipstream
entries.summary: Slipstream is a spell used to teleport away and may be used for strategic retreats or to get to a specific place quickly. After cast, the user quickly fades away in a pink aura and gets to the intended location.

entries.title: Lightcoat
entries.summary: Lightcoat is a defensive spell in the same vein as Honorguard that manifests through a pink aura.

entries.title: Lady S.
entries.summary: Lady S. is a nurse who works as a part of the Huntik Foundation. For a period of time, she worked as Metz's nurse and was responsible for looking after him in Metz's country estate in Germany. Following his recovery, she became an active field agent and joined the fight against the Blood Spirals.

entries.title: Drybite
entries.summary: Drybite is a Blood Spiral spell used to deal very high damage to a targeted Seeker or Titan. When cast, the spell appears as a stream of purple energy. It's able to send Kipperin and Powerbonded Sabriel (further protected by her Truth Shield ability) back to their amulets, as well as immobilize Powerbonded Sorcerel for a moment, all in a single use of the spell.

entries.title: Palamedes
entries.summary: Palamedes is a Krono-Titan used by White, one of the Nimue Casterwill's guardians. Dressed in a red cape, splintered golder armor and a shoulder plate over his right shoulder, Palamedes is a skilled warrior who wields a battle axe in combat. He is the brother of Mallory's Titan, Pellinore.

entries.title: Zan-Gason
entries.summary: Zan-Gason was a warlord and one of the leaders fighting for control of Sutos Island during its ten-year civil war. He served as Sutos' ruler prior to the return of Zan-Grier, who demanded his rightful spot as the island's true prince.

entries.title: Zan-Tanos
entries.summary: Zan-Tanos is a warlord who attempted to take control of Sutos Island by killing Zan-Gason. He was unsucessful however as Grier returned to claim his rightful place as ruler and The Organization took control of Sutos, ending the civil war that had plagued Sutos for so many years. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

entries.title: Zan-Sutos
entries.summary: Zan-Sutos was the former ruler of Sutos Island and the father of Grier.

entries.title: Airport attendant
entries.summary: The airport attendant works at the Marco Polo Airport. When Sophie Casterwill tried to books a flight, the attendant informed Sophie that both of her credit cards were denied. This was caused by The Organization. [All Work and No Pay]

entries.title: Rouen Police Office
entries.summary: The is a minor location where Peter was here wrongly imprisoned by the police commissioner under orders from the "special investigator," DeFoe. Zhalia Moon later helped Peter escape. [Into the River of Secrets]

entries.title: Police commissioner
entries.summary: The police commissioner held Peter in prison, under orders by DeFoe, at the Rouen Police Office of Rouen, France, until Zhalia Moon set Peter free by casting a Simplemind spell on the police commissioner. [Into the River of Secrets]

entries.title: Rouen hotel
entries.summary: The Rouen hotel is the hotel that Dante Vale's team stopped at while on a mission in Rouen, France, to recover the Amulet of Gar-Ghoul. While here, the hotel's concierge handed Dante a coded distress message from the Huntik Foundation guide, Peter, which was instinctively deciphered by Lok Lambert. [Into the River of Secrets]

entries.title: Concierge
entries.summary: A concierge worked at a hotel in Rouen, France. He gave Dante Vale's team a coded letter from the Huntik Foundation, although his knowledge of the world of Seekers and Titans remains undisclosed. [Into the River of Secrets]

entries.title: Shadowknife
entries.summary: Shadowknife is a spell used to throw magical knives at the enemy. The knives thrown will emit a purple glow, this spell can be cast while holding a knife or simply summoning it from the users hand. It is similar to the spell Knifepoint used by Celina and Bonnie.

entries.title: Slitherfoot
entries.summary: Slitherfoot is a spell which permits the user to walk on walls. It manifests itself as a blue aura around the user's legs.

entries.title: Black market trader
entries.summary: The black market trader supplied Dante Vale with medicine to treat Metz's curse.

entries.title: Old Madea Island inhabitant
entries.summary: The old Madea Island inhabitant was an elderly woman living on Madea Island who was created as an illusion by the Titan, Madea. This inhabitant told Zhalia Moon of a vast treasure on the island, but Zhalia was not interested. After exploring the island and perceiving it to have no other inhabitants, she accepted the offer. Upon finding the source of the island's illusions, and seeing the through t

entries.title: Young Madea Island inhabitant
entries.summary: The young Madea Island inhabitant was a girl on Madea Island who was created as an illusion by the Titan, Madea. This inhabitant was around the age of Lok Lambert. She led Lok to a puzzle purportedly left by his father, Eathon Lambert, after a temporary stay on the island.

entries.title: Madea Island Library
entries.summary:
The article is about the Library with the puzzle that Lok's father left behind. For the Library with the Casterwill legacies, see Madea Island Casterwill Library.

is a Library on Madea Island to where a girl brings Lok.
According to that girl, Lok's father left a puzzle behind, what could be a message from him to Lok. After a while of trying to solve it and failing, he thinks the puzzle is no fun

entries.title: Madea Island teacher
entries.summary:
The teacher on Madea Island was created as an illusion by the Titan, Madea. The teacher was teaching a group of children when she asked Cherit to take over the lessons for a while because she was unable to teach her more curriculum. [The Beautiful Trap]

it:Isola di Madea

entries.title: Madea Island pupils
entries.summary:
The pupils of Madea Island were an illusion of a group of young girls that were living on Madea Island which were created by the Titan, Madea. Their teacher, another illusion, wanted Cherit to take over her lessons. Cherit accepted this job and gave the children lessons about Madea and a hermit crab. [The Beautiful Trap]

it:Isola di Madea

entries.title: Hermit crab
entries.summary:
The hermit crab, native to Madea Island, was used by Cherit as learning material for his pupils on the island. The hermit crab became annoyed at Cherit, however, and lashed out at the Titan. [The Beautiful Trap]

it:Isola di Madea

entries.title: The Professor's Personal Guard
entries.summary: were the five strongest operatives of the Professor and his personal protective body. They received a mission from the Professor to bring Eathon Lambert to him. They followed and trailed him all across the world, battling at the gates of Atlantis, until they cornered him at a waterfall in the forests of Peru. [The Mission] They turned Eathon over to the Professor, but Eathon managed to escape by j

entries.title: Southern Romania Steam Train
entries.summary:
The is a steam train that the Huntik team used to go to a train station on the way to the Castle of Vlad Dracul. On the way, the train was attacked by Klaus' Suits. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs]

The train was later used again by Lok Lambert, Den Fears and Sophie Casterwill to return to the Vlad's Castle and contain the wild Titan Antedeluvian. [Lok's Leadership]

entries.title: Southern Romania Train Station
entries.summary: is a Train Station located in Southern Romania. The train with the Huntik Team stopped here. And the team travels from here to the Castle of Vlad Dracul.

entries.title: Governor of Sutos
entries.summary: The governor of Sutos serves as an advisor to Prince Zan-Grier of Sutos. He was previously loyal to Grier's father, Zan-Sutos, and remained so of his memory during the civil war of Sutos Island.

entries.title: Unnamed Suit 012
entries.summary: Unnamed Suit 012 is a Suit in the Organization who operates from the Temple of Thor in Iceland.

entries.title: Unnamed Suit 043
entries.summary: Unnamed Suit 043 is a Suit from the Organization. She operated from the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot in Paris, France.

entries.title: Amazons
entries.summary: The Amazons are a tribe of women who living in the Tiwilderness, deep in the Turkish forest. Being warriors, they are no damsels in distress and can stand their ground to fight valiantly when attacked. They are currently led by the young queen, Hippolyta, who inherited this title from her mother when she died.

entries.title: Weakenshade
entries.summary: Weakenshade is a violet-aura offensive spell. It drastically weakens the target or disable their powers. This spell is favored by Mr. Wilder as his go-to spell.

entries.title: Key of Nefertiti
entries.summary: The is a key located in the Tomb of Nefertiti the key is hidden behind a door with the icon of the Blood Spiral. The key can open the secret entrance of the Tomb of Tutankhamun.

entries.title: Hidesight
entries.summary: Hidesight is a spell used to completely hide objects or Titans from sight. This spell is similar to Camoforge, which is used to turn the caster invisible.

entries.title: Jason
entries.summary: Jason was an ancient Seeker from Greece who featured prominently in Greek mythology. He led a team known as the Argonauts, a band of heroes and sailors.

entries.title: Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot
entries.summary: The Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot is a large building containing Sir Lancelot's tomb and a hidden, underground sanctuary, where Sir Lancelot hid all of his treasures, including the Holy Grail, his Titan, Cavalier and books containing the Casterwill family secrets.

entries.title: Metz's country estate
entries.summary: A country estate is owned by Metz in Germany. There are no known enchantments to guard the house.

entries.title: Qwitonn
entries.summary: Qwitonn was a crazed 1st century Seeker known only as Qwitonn. He became obsessed with Jokoul Titans, and he traveled the continent collecting every Jokoul Amulet he could find. As he grew older, Qwitonn became a hermit living in the Carpathian Mountains. He was recorded as having twice visited a nearby village wearing his collection of Jokoul Amulets and little else.

entries.title: Huntik: Secrets & Seekers
entries.summary: Huntik: Secrets & Seekers is an Italian-based animated series that was created and directed by Iginio Straffi. It was animated by Rainbow S.p.A., a studio co-owned by Straffi and Viacom. Both seasons were co-produced by Rai Fiction and the first was co-produced by Big Bocca Productions. The visual designs, artwork, music, and story writing were all done at Rainbow in Italy while some scriptwriting

entries.title: TCG:Legendary Saga
entries.summary: Legendary Saga is the second card set of the Huntik Trading Card Game. Centering around the arc of the final nine episodes of Season 1, the set introduces the Ultra Rare Legendary Hero pile along with the Legendary Amulet Cards. The set also introduces two new groups of cards; the Bold Explorer Cards and the Sand Snakes.

entries.summary: Promotional Cards are a unique set of cards from the Huntik Trading Card Game that were released only during promotional events organised by Upper Deck. These included sneak previews, launch events, and national and regional tournaments. Some of the cards were distributed to all event participants while others were awarded as prizes for the players who made it further in the competitions. The firs

aliases: TCG:Shauna and Wind - Emissaries of Evil
entries.subtitle: Emissaries of Evil

entries.title: Stoneblade
entries.summary: Stoneblade is a spell that manifests a moving blade of energy through the ground to send towards the target.

entries.title: TCG:Huntik Holotome Tin
entries.summary: The Huntik Holotome Tin is a Huntik Trading Card Game collector's tin containing four randomized booster packs from the Secrets and Seekers, Legendary Saga and Omens and Legacies sets, and one of two exclusive Super Rare TIN- cards. The TIN can be used to store cards inside as well as serving as a collector's display item.

entries.title: Abyssalfall
entries.summary: Abyssalfall is a Blood Spiral spell used to create a small abyss beneath the feet of the target that can swallow the enemy. This spell is similar to Darkvoid, though is easier to escape.

entries.title: Nostradamus
entries.summary: Michel de Notre Dame, better known as Nostradamus, was an ancient Casterwill family seer and one of the most powerful Seekers in the family. He left many prophecies in the form of quatrains for the Casterwills and the Huntik Foundation that would be key in preventing the return of the Nullifiers.

entries.title: Frost Minion
entries.summary: Frost Minions are birdlike creatures made of ice who serve Ymir, the king of the frost giants. Along with the Ice Creature Titans, Ymir is capable of summoning an army of these Titans to do battle.

entries.title: Kindlestrike
entries.summary: Kindlestrike is a Casterwill family spell that creates a high-powered beam of blue energy that can stun or defeat an enemy.

entries.title: Pellinore
entries.summary: Pellinore is a Krono-Titan used by Mallory, a Casterwill Guardian of Nimue Casterwill. Donning a red cape, splintered golden armor and a shoulder plate over his left shoulder, Pellinore is a skilled swordsman and hand to hand fighter. He is the brother of White's Titan, Palamedes.

entries.title: Doorway to Huntik
entries.summary: Lok and the team travel to the South American waterfall where Eathon Lambert was last seen. There they discover both a new threat and a new source of clues.

entries.title: The Tower of Nostradamus
entries.summary: The Huntik team must regain control of Nostradamus' Tower after Wilder and his team come looking to uncover its secrets. Eathon contacts Lok and tells him he must find the Willblade, and Nostradamus' Scrying Glass will be vital in sending them in the right direction.

entries.title: Cave of the Casterwills
entries.summary: The Huntik team are joined by LeBlanche as they travel to England to begin their search for the legendary island of Avalon. Sophie and LeBlanche are separated and meet Nimue, a Casterwill Elder, while the others are locked in combat with her bodyguards. Sophie must earn Nimue’s trust to stop the fighting.

entries.title: Shadowlock
entries.summary: Shadowlock is a high level restrictive spell, only been known to be used by the Betrayer. A purple aura is shot from the user's fingers. It then emanates into a victim's back, surrounding them in the purple substance, rendering them immobilized.

entries.title: Knight of the Willblade
entries.summary: Seeking the Willblade, the Huntik team finally reaches the mythical island of Avalon with some help from Nimue. However, the team is ambushed by the Organization and a new Titan in Wilder's possession, Divine Mirror Kagami which was found by Hoffman, who can turn a Titan's power against it. Lok and Sophie find the Willblade. Ambushed by Wilder, Lok must unlock the true power of the Willblade with

entries.title: Chasing Void
entries.summary: Sophie's brother wants to stop the team from continuing their dangerous quest; Sophie resolves to complete a mission for Lucas and discover the location of Void, the mysterious and evil Titan.

entries.title: Powerbond
entries.summary: The Powerbond is a rare and advanced form of synchronization between a Titan and their Seeker. When the bond between a Seeker and their Titan reaches extraordinary strength, the Titan can become Powerbonded, transforming in appearance and gaining enhanced powers, new abilities, and perfect telepathic communication with its Seeker. Historically an incredibly rare phenomenon, the occurrence of Power

entries.title: The Blood Spiral
entries.summary: The Huntik team return to the lab of their old enemy, Klaus, where they face heavy resistance from Wilder and his team. However, both factions are soon ambushed by an even more deadly threat, the Blood Spiral...

entries.title: Den vs Harrison
entries.summary: Zhalia discovers a group of orphans that Tantras is trying to recruit for the Blood Spiral. One of them, Harrison, goes with Tantras to ambush Lok and Sophie as a test, but his brother, Den, goes to the Foundation for help.

entries.title: Zhalia's Mission
entries.summary: The Huntik team must race the Organization and a new team of Blood Spiral Casterwill Hunters, led by the explosive Kiel, to recover the dangerous Titan Medusa. However, the mission soon takes a drastic turn, forcing Zhalia to adopt a new plan.

entries.title: Sophie on Trial
entries.summary: The Casterwill family and Dante's team gather in the Fortress of Iron Will while the Blood Spiral's army prepares to wage war against the family. With Sophie's capabilities of leading the family called into question, she must face the Trial of Courage, with Lok as her Champion, to become the leader of the Casterwill elders. At the end of the tests lies the statue of the Legendary Titan of Bravery,

entries.title: King Arthur
entries.summary: King Arthur of Camelot was the head of the Knights of the Round Table and the husband of Guinevere. The legends of King Arthur are a central part of English and Medieval folklore, and include stories of Arthur's island of Avalon, resting place of the Willblade. His symbol was famously a dragon.

entries.title: The Legendary Titan of Fate
entries.summary: When Clements goes missing, the Huntik team are sent to Paris, to find him. After a battle with some possessed Titans outside of the Cathedral of Notre Dame, the they find Clements is trapped in a dream world created by the Ring of Arc. To rescue him, the team must each enter a dream world, each showing them the nightmares of their future.

entries.title: Pied Piper
entries.summary: The Pied Piper was a Seeker from the Middle Ages. He helped to stop a Gremlow infestation in Germany before enacting a devastating revenge by leading away all of the town's children.

entries.title: Boys Will Be Seekers
entries.summary: Den and Harrison Fears both train with their factions. Den is recruited by the Huntik team to replace Zhalia but the pressure gets too much and he runs away. Lok and Cherit race to find him before Tantras and the Blood Spiral do.

entries.title: The Casterwill Connection
entries.summary: The Huntik team are sent to Manhattan to rescue Focauld, a Casterwill Elder who has been targeted by Kiel and his powerful Blood Spiral team. They not only have to fight their way out of the Cloisters, but Focauld’s contrary personality isn’t making it any easier.

entries.title: The Titan in the Temple of Sun
entries.summary: Dante, Lok, Den, and Sophie meet with the Huntik Foundation Council. The Casterwill Elder, Teien, asks them to find and activate the Blue Star to signify the meeting of Casterwill Elders.

entries.title: Overslam
entries.summary: Overslam is a spell used to increase the power of a Seeker's charge, creating a blue aura in front of the user's body. The casting Seeker can then use this force to push someone or something like a magical battering ram, helping to clear the path. Overslam can also be used to save someone in a moment with a charging leap. This spell is used heavily by Lok Lambert.

entries.title: Nasher
entries.summary: Nasher is a member of the Huntik Foundation Council. He currently quarters in Huntik International HQ in New York City. He is also in charge of the Foundation base in Tower of Nostradamus in Salon, France.

entries.title: Camoforge
entries.summary: Camoforge is an illusory spell used by members of the Huntik Foundation that allows a Seeker to turn invisible. It is similar to Hidesight, which can turn Titans or objects invisible.

entries.title: Fate of the Father
entries.summary: Fate of the Father was a mission assigned to the Huntik team to uncover the whereabouts of Eathon Lambert, the father of Lok Lambert, upon discovering his last known location from an Organization file. The Huntik Team travelled on the Huntik Foundation jet to South America to investigate the waterfall where Eathon and the Professor had their final battle. On the mission, they discovered Eathon was

entries.title: Powermark
entries.summary: Powermark sacrifices a Titan and gives the Seeker who used this spell its energy, based on the Titan's level of power. When used in conjunction with Doublespell, the Titan's energy can be shared between two Seekers.

entries.title: Terrorsight
entries.summary: Terrorsight is an illusory spell. It is used by the members of the Blood Spiral to show someone their greatest fear. The victim's eyes also glow as this happens.

entries.title: The Seer's Tower
entries.summary: The Seer's Tower was a mission assigned to Dante Vale by Metz to investigate Organization activity in Salon, France, in Nostradamus' tower. After evading an Organization aircraft's seeker missiles and destroying the plane, the Huntik Team is able to free the hostages from the museum, Peter, Billie and another female operative. The team, making use of Nostradamus' magic and Sentry Triclops Titans,

entries.title: Tower of Nostradamus
entries.summary: The Tower of Nostradamus is one of the Huntik Foundation's bases located in Salon, France. Peter, Billie, and Annette quarter here.

entries.title: Huntik Foundation Council
entries.summary: The Huntik Foundation Council is a group consisting of nine (later ten) of the most experienced Huntik Foundation Seekers from across the globe, controlling the Foundation's work and making important decisions about future goals, alliances and missions. They are based in Huntik International HQ in Manhattan, New York.

entries.title: Momax
entries.summary: Momax is a member of the Huntik Foundation Council who is quite plump in size. He is often seen to sit between Metz and Nasher.

entries.title: Dante's Return
entries.summary: The Huntik team falters in the final battle against the Betrayer and his powerful Legendary Titan of Betrayal, Demigorgan, but a newly empowered Lok and a resurrected teammate turn the tide.

entries.title: Uffizi
entries.summary: Ms. Uffizi is a member of the Huntik Foundation Council. Currently quartered in Huntik International HQ with the other members, she speaks with a distinctive Italian accent.

entries.title: TCG:SAS-154
aliases: TCG:Get the Argo Out of the Water

entries.title: Everheal
entries.summary: Everheal is a healing spell similar to Everfight that can be used to heal another Seeker by enveloping the target in an amber aura.

entries.title: Shocklash
entries.summary: Shocklash is a high-level spell utilized by the Betrayer that creates a powerful stream of red energy. The sheer impact of this spell can be used to force back the enemy in addition to causing significant damage. It is powerful enough to defeat powerful Titans like Jericho, despite his ability to absorb energy-based attacks.

entries.title: Powerlock
entries.summary: Powerlock is a spell that allows a Seeker to sacrifice one of his or her Titans to gain the Titan's energy, drastically powering up the Seeker. It is very similar to Powermark.

entries.title: Lodestone Guardian
entries.summary: The Lodestone Guardians, nicknamed "rock heads" by Lok Lambert, are golem-like entities that serve as a defense mechanism for the Lodestone, near the Phoenix Volcano. Powered and controlled entirely by the Lodestone, they act as automated security units built specifically to protect the labyrinth chamber, with the Lodestone's anti-magic field completely preventing the use of Magic or Titans agains

entries.summary: The Amazonian second-in-command is second only to Queen Hippolyta in the Amazon nation. Her actual name is thus far unknown.

entries.title: Jason and the Argonauts
entries.summary: Jason and the Argonauts was the mission assigned to Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, and Zhalia Moon by Guggenheim to find the Argo and to retrieve Jason's logbook with his Hoplite Titans. [The Treasures of the Argonauts] The mission was completed after reaching an understanding with Grier. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

entries.title: Deadcalm
entries.summary: Deadcalm is one of Klaus's creations, made from pieces of a tablet inscribed with the power Breakspell. It has the power to burrow into its target and completely drain them of the ability to use magic.

entries.title: The Tomb of Nefertiti
entries.summary: The Tomb of Nefertiti was the mission assigned to Dante, Lok, Sophie, and Zhalia in "All Work and No Pay" by Guggenheim when he made investigating the Tomb of Nefertiti an official Huntik Foundation Mission. [All Work and No Pay]

entries.title: Elder Guardian of Thor
entries.summary: The Elder Guardian of Thor is one of the Guardians of Thor who guards the secrets of the Temple of Thor.

entries.title: Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory is one of the ancient guardians of Nimue Casterwill and works alongside White, guarding the secrets of the Crystal Caves on the coast of England and protecting the current Lady of the Lake, Vivian Casterwill.

entries.title: Lastedge
entries.summary: Lastedge is a magical defense engineered by Klaus that forms a protective, yellow net around the caster. Running along this net are numerous spines containing a toxin that can induce blindness.

entries.title: Hexkill
entries.summary: Hexkill is a spell used to disspell enchantments, and spells. The spell manifests as a stream of red or green energy from the hands of the user.

entries.title: The Titans of Vlad Dracul
entries.summary: The Titans of Vlad Dracul was the mission given to Dante, Lok, Sophie, and Zhalia in which they had to travel to the Castle of Vlad Dracul. They almost failed the mission when Zhalia almost betrayed the team. [The Vampire Loses Its Fangs] Although they managed to retrieve Vlad's bag of amulets it was later revealed that Antedeluvian was still running wild in Vlad's Castle. [Lok's Leadership]

entries.title: The Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot
entries.summary: The Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot was the mission assigned to Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, and Sophie Casterwill by Guggenheim. The mission was to retrieve Sir Lancelot's treasures and to deliver them to a safehouse.

entries.title: The Legendary Titan of Body
entries.summary: The Legendary Titan of Body was the mission assigned to Dante, Lok, and Sophie in "Ladies' Choice". The mission was to retrieve the Legendary Titan of Body, Behemoth, which Metz had left behind in the Amazon village. The team ran into some trouble with the Amazons but were able to gain their trust but their laws prevented them from taking anything from the village. Zhalia arrived and challenged Hi

entries.title: White
entries.summary: White is one of the ancient guardians of Nimue Casterwill and works alongside Mallory, guarding the secrets of the Crystal Caves on the coast of England and protecting the current Lady of the Lake, Vivian Casterwill.

aliases: TCG:Eathon Lambert, Bold Explorer - Young Adventurer
entries.subtitle: Young Adventurer

entries.title: Eathon Lambert's puzzle
entries.summary: Eathon's Puzzle is a key that unlocks the Amulet of Will from its resting place in Atlantis.

entries.title: King Solomon's Mines
entries.summary: King Solomon's Mines was the mission assigned to Dante Vale, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, and Zhalia Moon. Their goal was to reach King Solomon's mines and recover the Legendary Titan of Spirit, Tao.

entries.title: Secrets of the Organization
entries.summary: Secrets of the Organization was the mission assigned to Dante, Lok, Sophie  and Zhalia in "The Secret of Two Generations". In order to find the last legendary titan, Araknos the team must find out what happen to Simon Judeau. Following an Organization connect the team discovers the truth about the Organization's beginning and the Professor. [The Secret of Two Generations]

entries.title: Magic
entries.summary: Magic is one of the primary abilities of a Seeker and allows the user to cast a variety of spells or powers. Amulets, as well as other artifacts, often are infused with various forms of magical properties. Such magic spells have a variety of uses and effects to affect either the caster or another target.

entries.summary: The Mist of Avalon was the mission assigned to the Huntik team in which their goal was to investigate Avalon and its connection to the Casterwill family. After arriving in England the team were attacked by White and Mallory but Sophie was able prove to Nimue Casterwill that they were friends. entries.title: Banebound
entries.summary: Banebound is a powerful Casterwill spell used to contain the spells and curses on objects so they can be handled without fear. It can only hold the spell or curse for a certain time depending on the power of the user and the curse.

entries.title: Firebrand
entries.summary: Firebrand is a spell that creates a fiery aura of purple energy on the caster's hands.

entries.title: Clatterbang
entries.summary: Clatterbang is a spell that creates a sonic wave that can instantly knock out the opponent. The spell user's hands are placed on either side of the target's head, and a wave with a violet aura is emitted from the hands.

entries.title: Shieldbreaker
entries.summary: Shieldbreaker is a spell used to disable an enemy's protective spell to leave an opening to attack directly.

entries.title: Poisonheat
entries.summary: Poisonheat is a spell that produces a caustic green sludge from the casting Seeker's hands and directs at the target. This spell is similar to the acid that Kreutalk spits and to the Poisonfang spell.

entries.title: Gunther Von Bulow
entries.summary: Gunter Von Bulow was one of the participants at the summer camp at Germany where the 8 years old Guggenheim also participated. He and his group, including Guggenheim and one American boy, were assigned for some type of survival competition, spending the night in the woods without any adults. His team had been organized very well.

entries.title: The Power of Umbra
entries.summary: The Huntik team regroup in California as they dive down into Hernán Cortés' vault in search of Umbra the Shadow Jaguar, the Legendary Titan of Dimensions. However, a fight breaks out, forcing Dante to pull out all the stops.

entries.title: Huntik.com/Ask Guggenheim
entries.summary: The Ask Guggenheim Blog was a weekly blog posted on Huntik.com that answered a question of one registered user each week about a day before the new episode. The questions and some answers are archived below.

entries.title: Sunlock
entries.summary:
Sunlock is a restrictive spell. It creates a pair of handcuffs made up of amber energy rendering an ennemy unable to cast spells.
It is a favored spell of Lucas Casterwill.

entries.title: Mucalin
entries.summary: Mucalin is a snake-like Yama-Titan with seven heads much like the Greek Hydra. A similar Titan, Hydramaskar, influenced Aztec mythology where Mucalin influenced Buddhist mythology. Mucalin also appears to be related to another orange cobra-like Titan, Slitherfang.

entries.title: Riptide
entries.summary: Riptide is an spell used to fire a high-powered jet of water. This spell manifests as a blue aura on the caster's hand.

entries.title: Billie
entries.summary: Billie is a pretty Seeker on the Huntik Foundation who reports to Nasher. She works undercover at the Tower of Nostradamus in Salon, France, alongside Peter and Annette.

entries.title: The Spiral War
entries.summary: The meeting of the Casterwill Elders is disrupted when Kiel and his Spiral Army attack. The Huntik team fights alongside the Casterwills, and Sophie faces Kiel. Nimue, a Casterwill Elder, uses Soulburn to get some of the Spirals to flee, but at a price. Nimue sacrifices her life. Bonding with Powerbonded Sorcerel, Sophie barely wins, leaving Lok to save her from a rampaging Efreet King. After the

entries.title: The School of Mystery
entries.summary: The School of Mystery is the first issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: Belgrieve
entries.summary: Belgrieve the Death Knight is a powerful Krono-Titan used by Ford. Deprived of eyes, Belgrieve is said to be guided by the aura of life in order to generate death.

entries.title: Silver Hunter
entries.summary: Silver Hunter is a Meso-Titan tracker favored by Dr. Rickman. With silver fut and razor sharp fangs, it possesses exceptional hunting abilities.

entries.title: The Titan of the Forest
entries.summary: The Titan of the Forest is the second issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

entries.title: Arawn the Hunter
entries.summary: Arawn the Hunter is a Draco-Titan archer that belonged to the legendary Robin Hood. Arawn was left to reside in Barnsdale Forest in Yorkshire, England until his Amulet was recovered by Lok Lambert.

entries.title: Elegast
entries.summary: Elegast the Rogue Elf is a small, gnome-like Titan. Despite his small appearance, Elegast is a talented and deceiving trickster, carrying several bags of sand, being able to force his enemies to fall asleep in the middle of battle. Elegast is the primary Titan of Ryder.

entries.title: Executioner
entries.summary: Executioner is a large Litho-Titan whose face is hidden behind a black executioner's mask. Executioner Titans have been seen in the possession of two Organization Seekers, Gregor and Lee Roy.

entries.title: Gregor
entries.summary: Gregor is a member of the Organization who was often teamed with Ford and Ryder. The epitome of a callous brute, Gregor is aggressive and violent, with the appearance, in Cherit's words, of a gorilla.

entries.title: Ryder
entries.summary: Ryder was a member of the Organization and an old acquaintance of Zhalia Moon. He often worked alongside Ford and Gregor, bringing the stealth and cunning to their missions.

entries.title: Ancient Marbles
entries.summary: The Anchient Marbles were used like a key to open an wall that contains a treasure.

entries.title: Ford
entries.summary: Ford is a former student of the Venice Preparation Academy and a former member of the Organization. He currently serves as a reliable operative of the Huntik Foundation.

entries.title: Dr. Rickman
entries.summary: Dr. Rickman is a top operative of the Organization. He has two female minions called Celina and Bonnie. A collector of ancient relics, he is an old enemy of Dante Vale.

entries.title: Ford's Gang
entries.summary: Ford's Gang is a branch of the Organization consisting of students from the Venice Preparation Academy. Their leader is Ford.

entries.title: Lok and the Betrayer
entries.summary: The Betrayer returns to life and attacks, crippling the Huntik Foundation with the news of Dante's death. Zhalia makes a confession and pushes Harrison to act.

entries.title: Gremlow Infestation!
entries.summary: Lok, Sophie and Den meet with Guggenheim to investigate a rogue Titan, Gremlow, in Hamelin Cathedral. Unfortunately the Titan keeps multiplying. Meanwhile, Dante explores the cavern of Hernán Cortés in order to locate the Titan Umbra.

entries.title: Vlad Dracul
entries.summary: Vlad Dracul (also known as Vlad the Impaler, Vlad Tepes, and Dracula) was an ancient and evil Seeker, and an enemy of the Casterwill family. Due to his reputation for evil and inhuman cruelty, ordinary people figured him to be a monster. With his vampiric Titan, Antedeluvian, Vlad became known as the vampire, Dracula.

entries.title: Kronos
entries.summary: Kronos is the Legendary Titan of Time and the progenitor of the Krono-Titans. A hooded figure in the visage of the Grim Reaper, Kronos dons purple and gold armor and wields a large scythe, capable of wiping out those he strikes from ever having been born.

entries.title: Frostanna
entries.summary: Frostanna is a Litho-Titan used by Ford. Also known as the Snow Lady, she can control ice, freezing water particles in the air through her hair and generating cooling rays from her long claws.

entries.title: Wendigo
entries.summary: Wendigo is a Meso-Titan used by Dr. Rickman to defeat Dante Vale and steal his ancient Mayan / Aztecan bowl in the past.

entries.title: Ms. Thorpe
entries.summary: Miss Thorpe is a Suit working for the Organization, previously commanded by DeFoe. She is one of the group's operatives working out of Venice, Italy.

entries.title: Slipsnare
entries.summary: Slipsnare is a power that allows the caster to create a bundle of invisible rope that wraps around the target's ankles, immobilizing them.

entries.title: Auraforce
entries.summary: Auraforce is a powerful offensive spell used by members of the Blood Spiral that creates a blue or purple aura which sends out a large burst or wave of energy.

entries.title: Ms. Shrodinger
entries.summary: Ms. Shrodinger is an elderly woman who served as the caretaker of an orphanage in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

entries.title: Madea Island Casterwill Library
entries.summary: The Madea Island Casterwill Library is a Casterwill building on Madea Island that contains books about the Casterwill legacy.

entries.title: Shadow Kuolit
entries.summary: Shadow Kuolit is a Yama-Titan with the face of an Oni. This Titan in samurai armor possesses the unique ability to fight by using a sentient shadow.

entries.title: Trapcage
entries.summary: Trapcage is a restrictive spell. It traps an opponent in a sphere of orange energy. This confinement can then be transported via magic or used to cause pain for the prisoner.

entries.title: Robin Hood
entries.summary: Robin Hood was a powerful Seeker and archer.
