entries.title: Huntik.com/Adventure Game
entries.summary: The Adventure Game was an interactive online game on Huntik.com that allowed registered users to go on Seeker missions in chapters corresponding to each episode of Huntik. Each Adventure Game chapter had different choices that could be taken which would affect the outcome of the chapter. entries.title: Spear of Vlad the Impaler
entries.summary: The Spear of Vlad the Impaler is an artifact that was necessary to enter the Castle of Vlad Dracul and at one time held the Titan Antedeluvian. It is able to unlock the castle by being inserted into the molded wound of one of the statues at the castle's gates.

entries.title: Argo
entries.summary: The Argo was a mythical ship owned and used by Jason and the Argonauts that was sunk just off of the shores of Sutos Island. Many of the Argonauts' treasures were sealed away here including the Apple of Paris, Hercules' Arrow the Golden Fleece and the Hoplite Amulets that were recovered by Dante Vale's team.

entries.title: Dr. Benway
entries.summary: Dr. Benway is a member of the Organization who fought against his leader, the Professor, for control of Kronos. He is a descendant of Viktor Casterwill, who betrayed the Casterwill family, making him a disowned member of the Casterwill clan. His assistant is Miss Fitch.

entries.title: Triton
entries.summary: Triton is a rare, aquatic Krono-Titan that resembles a heavily armored merman. Unlike other Titans that look completely identical across multiple invocations, Triton is unique in that each of the four known Amulets contains an individualised, alternate version of the Titan, including a much darker, corrupted fourth variant.

entries.title: Megladeath
entries.summary: Megladeath is a gargantuan Draco-Titan sea-monster that resembles a blue-bodied plesiosaur with a spiked red helmet. The undisputed lord of the sea, Megladeath is used by the Organization for aquatic combat.

entries.title: Earthband
entries.summary: Earthband is a defensive spell that projects a barrier that can redirect incoming attacks at will. This spell is used by Hoffman.

entries.title: Grand Dragon Leviathan
entries.summary: Grand Dragon Leviathan is the Legendary Titan of the Deeps. This Titan resembles a massive, green, serpentine dragon, much like Shakrit. Leviathan's wings are small with respect to its body, contrasting Shakrit's much larger wings.

entries.title: Polymaximus
entries.summary: Polymaximus is a wild Krono-Titan who resides freely on the Island of Sinbad. He appears as a fearsome giant dressed in golden armor.

entries.title: Avalon
entries.summary: Avalon is mystical island that is very prominent in Celtic lore and mythology, and the resting place of the powerful Casterwill weapon, the Willblade.

entries.title: Nexus
entries.summary: The Nexus is a gateway to the Spirit World of Huntik, the world from which the Titans originated. The Nexus in Peru is a large, blue colored crystal situated within a cave behind a waterfall.

entries.title: The Phoenix's Ashes
entries.summary: The team continues on their mission with Montehue and Tersly. They come up with a plan to take out the Silent Soldiers guarding the volcano's entrance. While Montehue and Tersly hold off the guards, Dante, Lok, Den, and Sophie face off against Wind and Shauna. Sophie knows she must face her fears as the lava calls for her to dive in.

entries.title: Shifter
entries.summary: Shifter is a Draco-Titan whose appearance is that of a majestic carnival mask with a ghostly purple cape. With exceptional shape-shifting abilities, Shifter's Amulet is in the possession of Ryder.

entries.title: Araknos' Tomb
entries.summary: Araknos Tomb is an ancient temple and was the resting place of the ring of Araknos, the Legendary Titan of Mind. In addition to some wild Titans, it was protected by the Curse of the Legendary Titans.

entries.title: Bladestorm
entries.summary: Bladestorm is a powerful Blood Spiral spell that creates a onslaught of sharp blades levitating in the air.

entries.title: Casterwill Hunters
entries.summary: The Casterwill Hunters are members of the Blood Spiral that are specially trained to kill members of the Casterwill family through any means necessary. Even more dangerous than the Silent Soldiers, they have no shame in destroying members of the Huntik Foundation for being allies of the Casterwills.

entries.title: Ra-Tet
entries.summary: Ra-Tet is a Sun-powered Hecto-Titan who has been missing for thousands of years. Not much has been uncovered about this Titan aside from it being the rival Titan of Slitherfang.

entries.title: Slitherfang
entries.summary: Slitherfang, the serpent from the Nile, is a snake-like Hecto-Titan that combines attributes of the boa constrictor with those of a cobra. His rival is the Sun-based Hecto-Titan, Ra-Tet. This Titan appears to be related to another cobra Titan, Mucalin.

entries.title: The Dead Magic Island
entries.summary: On an island where powers and Titans don’t work, the Spirals are searching a volcano for the Legendary Titan, Phoenix. To stop them, our heroes with Montehue and Tersly must first destroy the very thing that makes powers inactive: the Lodestone.

entries.title: Lok's Leadership
entries.summary: With Dante away in China, Lok leads his first mission, to capture the wild Titan, Antedeluvian at the Castle of Vlad Dracul. However, it might also be his last when Tantras and an empowered Harrison turn up.
